title: Senior People Operations & Payroll Manager (f/m/x)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at IONITY GmbH
description_html:
Your mission

IONITY is building the backbone of electric mobility in Europe. Founded by leading automotive manufacturers, we operate Europe’s largest high-power charging network across 24 countries, enabling seamless long-distance travel for EV drivers. With thousands of charging points already in operation and significant expansion ahead, IONITY is evolving beyond charging infrastructure into a broader mobility, energy and digital platform. 

As Senior People Ops & Payroll Manager, you'll ensure IONITY's People Operations and payroll run accurately, on time and with care across our multi-country European setup. This is a hands-on role for someone who knows payroll inside out, enjoys making processes cleaner and more scalable, and wants the admin side of work to feel effortless for employees. 

You'll own the payroll cycle end to end, keep our employee data and lifecycle processes in great shape, and be the go-to partner for our external payroll providers, People Partners and employees. 

What you'll do 

  • Own the monthly payroll process across countries, including preparatory payroll accounting, inputs, handovers and sign-off with external payroll providers.
  • Keep employee master data in Personio & Deel accurate, compliant and audit-ready.
  • Manage core lifecycle processes (onboarding, leave, offboarding), including work time accounts, eAUadministration and work certificates.
  • Act as a main contact for payroll providers, tax advisors and auditors, and resolve issues quickly and professionally.
  • Spot friction in processes, systems and workflows, then fix it, using automation and exploring AI where they add real value.
  • Support the alignment of employee benefits across countries while respecting local requirements.
  • Partner closely with People Partners and Finance so payroll, reporting and People processes join up.
  • Answer employee questions on pay and HR admin with clarity and discretion.
  • Guide or mentor junior team members, own larger process and system projects, and act as a sparring partner to People leadership.


Your profile

  • 5 years of experience in payroll and People / HR Operations, ideally including German payroll.
  • Experience coordinating payroll across multiple countries, working with external providers. 
  • Strong knowledge of relevant labor law, tax and social security requirements, with a willingness to learn new countries.
  • Hands-on experience with Deel & Personio is a strong plus.
  • A structured, reliable and discreet way of working, with a real eye for detail and deadlines.
  • A pragmatic, improvement-minded approach: you like clean processes, but not bureaucracy for its own sake.
  • Curiosity about how systems, automation and AI can make work better.
  • Fluent English and German; another European language is a bonus.
  • Proven ownership of multi-country payroll and experience leading process or system improvements, or guiding others.

description_html:
Your new team:

As a Senior Software Engineer (m/f/d) at auxmoney, you’ll join our IT Risk & Pricing team, where we build backend systems and services that support risk decisioning, pricing, and data-driven product logic. The work is backend-heavy, involving complex technical problem-solving and close integration with data/analytics workflows. 
 
In this role, you’ll design and deliver impactful features, help evolve a scalable, resilient architecture, and take end-to-end ownership from concept through production. You’ll work closely with analysts/data scientists, product managers, and business stakeholders to ship high-quality solutions and continuously improve our engineering standards. If you are passionate about writing clean, maintainable code, solving complex technical challenges, and building software that delivers real value, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact.


What you can expect:

  • Architecture & System Design: Identify and address architectural limitations, make pragmatic trade-offs, and help evolve systems toward scalability, reliability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Technical Leadership: Act as a trusted technical expert by promoting engineering best practices, facilitating technical discussions, and helping teams align on high-quality solutions.
  • Engineering Quality: Build solutions that are secure, scalable, extensible, and cost-efficient while maintaining high coding and documentation standards.
  • Execution & Delivery: Break down complex initiatives into manageable workstreams and deliver incremental value through iterative development.
  • Impact & Knowledge Sharing: Champion engineering excellence, share knowledge proactively, and support the professional growth of colleagues.
  • Collaboration & Problem Solving: Work closely with cross-functional stakeholders, actively contribute to design reviews, and address root causes of recurring technical challenges.
  • Ownership & Mentorship: Take responsibility for challenging projects and guide team members through technical mentoring and hands-on support.
  • Strategic Thinking & Growth Mindset: Balance short-term delivery with long-term system sustainability and continuously look for opportunities to improve technology, processes, and team effectiveness.


Your profile

  • Backend Engineering Expertise: Several years of hands-on backend development experience with preferably strong proficiency in PHP, particularly using the Symfony framework and Python.
  • System & API Development: Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining robust backend systems in production environments, including strong expertise in developing and integrating RESTful APIs.
  • SQL Expertise: Hands-on SQL experience in application development, with strong proficiency in relational data modelling (table design, keys, and constraints) and writing complex, performant queries to support business features.
  • Cloud & DevOps Practices: Experience working with cloud platforms (preferably AWS) and modern DevOps practices such as CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and infrastructure automation. Experience with Docker and Kubernetes is highly valued.
  • Event-Driven Architecture (Bonus): Familiarity with Kafka or similar event-driven messaging systems is considered a strong advantage.
  • Testing & Quality Assurance: Solid understanding of automated testing strategies, including unit and integration testing, with a focus on delivering reliable and high-quality software aligned with overall quality standards.
  • Product-Oriented Mindset: A strong focus on building solutions that deliver measurable value for users and business outcomes.
  • Team & Communication Skills: Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and contribute to a supportive engineering culture.
  • Security & Compliance Awareness: A proactive approach to implementing security best practices and ensuring compliance throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Language Skills: Fluent written and spoken English.


What we offer:

  • Flexibility for Your Lifestyle: Enjoy family-friendly working hours and a generous home office policy, allowing you to stay agile and flexible in any situation.
  • Ergonomic Work Environment: For your office days, we provide ergonomic workstations that offer you a comfortable and healthy workspace.
  • Independent Work: With short decision-making paths, we enable you to work autonomously and actively contribute your ideas – we provide space for you to take on responsibility.
  • Grow with Us: Unlock your potential with numerous opportunities for growth and development, along with an annual development budget to help you achieve your professional and personal goals.
  • Team Spirit: Team spirit is important to us – we regularly host events and parties where fun is guaranteed.
  • Mobility Your Way: Whether you prefer a train ticket or parking – we support your choice of preferred mobility.
  • Stay Active: Keep fit with a discounted membership at Fitness First or Urban Sports Club, or use our in-house fitness room to stay active after work and enhance your work-life balance.
  • Secure Your Future: Think about your future – we offer subsidies for company pension plans so you can plan long-term with us.
  • Tailored Benefits: We consider your personal life situation – whether you're a parent or love to travel, we offer customized benefits to suit your lifestyle.

For us as an employer, equal opportunities and diversity are especially important. Therefore, we welcome applications from mothers, fathers, people with disabilities and people from the LGBTQIA+ community. Please feel free to let us know if, for example, you would like us to use a gender-neutral pronoun, if you need barrier-free access to our office, or if you would like us to allow more time for the application process.

title: Training Specialist (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at DocuWare
description_html:
Why should you join?

DocuWare stands for globally distributed, international teams and an open corporate culture that invites you to help shape it. Mobile Work and flexible working hours are part of our everyday life. Would you like to be part of an innovative company whose solutions are digitizing everyday work in a wide range of industries? In that case, we are happy to welcome you to the team.


Your Responsibilities

As a Training Specialist (m/f/d), you will empower our sales teams and partners to successfully sell, confidently demonstrate, and effectively implement DocuWare solutions for our customers. Leveraging your expertise, you will develop modern learning programs, deliver engaging training experiences, and play a key role in strengthening the success of our sales and partner organizations.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • You plan, coordinate, and deliver training programs for our sales teams and partners, ensuring an engaging and effective learning experience.
  • You design modern training concepts and define appropriate methodologies and instructional approaches to enable sustainable knowledge transfer.
  • You create, update, and continuously improve training programs based on business requirements and learning objectives.
  • You develop and maintain high-quality training materials, including course content, e-learning modules, assessments, and certification programs.
  • You collaborate closely with sales teams, partners, and cross-functional stakeholders to align training content with business needs and audience expectations.
  • You support the creation, maintenance, and enhancement of product demonstrations for our sales teams and partners.
  • You act as a subject matter expert in meetings, workshops, and events, providing guidance on sales and product-related topics.
  • You identify opportunities to improve existing training offerings and actively contribute new ideas to enhance our learning and enablement programs.


What you need to succeed

  • You hold a degree in Education, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field, or have gained equivalent qualifications through relevant professional experience.
  • You are skilled at adapting to different audiences and levels of expertise, delivering content in a clear, practical, and impactful way.
  • You have ideally gained experience in training, enablement, learning & development, or technical support.
  • You are proficient in Microsoft Office, CRM systems, and modern presentation and collaboration tools, and you are confident delivering both in-person and virtual training sessions.
  • You have a solid understanding of the customer journey, sales processes, and common sales methodologies such as SPIN.
  • You possess a strong understanding of business processes and their translation into digital workflows, and you can quickly familiarize yourself with complex software solutions.
  • Experience with DocuWare or other document management solutions is an advantage.
  • You are fluent in both German and English, with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • You work independently, thrive in international team environments, and bring strong communication, networking, and interpersonal skills.


What we can offer

There are many great reasons to join DocuWare - our company culture is only one of them.
 As part of the DocuWare team, you will benefit from many advantages:

  • Globally distributed, international teams: You will find our teams working in Germering, New York, Sofia or other worldwide locations.
  • Flexible work location and hours: You work hybrid - on the road or in our modern office - and you have the flexibility to arrange your own working hours.
  • Individual support: After an intensive induction, you will receive regular training tailored to your needs (e.g. conferences internal team building measures).
  • Well-earned rest: 35 vacation days per year, sport offerings, massages, a football table and a relaxing lounge area.
  • Mental health support: With our employee assistance program you have free and confidential access to resources and support for your well-being and stress management at any time.
  • Healthy food: Together we enjoy Fairtrade coffee with organic milk or oat milk, snacks and fresh fruit - all free of charge - as well as subsidized lunch from the Foodji fridge.
  • Free Tuesday Lunch: Every Tuesday, enjoy a complimentary and varied lunch.
  • Good accessibility: Choose how you would like to come to the office with a leased e-bike, by train or via highways A96/A99 (you can charge your e-car on site for free).
  • Team spirit: Regular employee and team events (virtual or on-site) ensure excellent collaboration with colleagues around the world.
  • Sustainability and social commitment: DocuWare stands for paperless work and supports volunteer organizations and local sports clubs.
  • Planning for your future: DocuWare subsidizes your company pension plan!
  • We offer a stable job with a well established and growing company.
  • Unique benefits: Choose one of three great options (Bonago, E-Gym or subsidized Deutschlandticket) to suit your needs.
  • We only use the latest technologies - find out more on Stackshare.
  • Up to 30 Days Work from Abroad: Experience international opportunities and broaden your horizons.
  • Family First: Preferential registration in our selected daycare center in Germering (no guarantee).
  • Buddy Program: You'll be paired with a buddy, who will support you during your onboarding and offer valuable tips.
For better insights, check us out on Instagram!

title: Senior PreSales Consultant (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at DocuWare
description_html:
Why should you join?

DocuWare stands for globally distributed, international teams and an open corporate culture that invites you to help shape it. Mobile Work and flexible working hours are part of our everyday life. Would you like to be part of an innovative company whose solutions are digitizing everyday work in a wide range of industries? In that case, we are happy to welcome you to the team.


Your Responsibilities

As a Senior Presales Consultant, you steer complex sales cycles and align technical capabilities with clear business outcomes to move strategic opportunities forward. You work hand in hand with Sales Directors, Partner Managers, and Professional Services, and you coach less experienced Presales Consultants on intricate pursuits. You apply a solution-selling approach to shape credible solution concepts and build stakeholder confidence through advanced sales stages.

Deal support

  • You take ownership of complex opportunities and guide them from discovery through validation.
  • You join pivotal partner and customer meetings to clarify objectives, risks, and success criteria.
  • You analyze requirements and business processes to uncover gaps and measurable outcomes.
  • You design solution concepts that align with the customer’s architecture, security standards, and priorities.
  • You lead the technical validation needed to advance late-stage deals and reduce risk.

Demonstrations

  • You deliver tailored demonstrations that reflect roles, data flows, and desired outcomes.
  • You prepare dedicated demo environments and opportunity-specific scenarios.
  • You communicate business value and solution fit with clear, outcome-focused messaging.
  • You adapt content and flow to address specific use cases and stakeholder concerns.

Technical validation

  • You plan and support proofs of concept for strategic pursuits, defining scope, success metrics, and timelines.
  • You handle in-depth technical questions throughout the sales cycle and coordinate SME input where needed.
  • You contribute to high-quality responses for RFPs and technical questionnaires.
  • You assess feasibility against customer requirements and propose workable alternatives.

Opportunity collaboration

  • You partner with Sales Directors and Partner Managers to shape strategy, next steps, and executive alignment.
  • You share structured feedback on recurring requirements and objections to refine positioning.
  • You provide insights that strengthen competitive differentiation and the overall solution narrative.
  • You ensure a smooth handover to Professional Services with clear scope, assumptions, and identified risks.
  • You mentor more junior Presales Consultants on complex opportunities, sharing best practices and review support.


What you need to succeed

  • You have proven experience supporting complex sales opportunities in a presales, solution consulting, or technical customer-facing role; this is a must-have.
  • You bring several years of successful experience in solution selling, presales, or professional services, ideally in software or SaaS.
  • You demonstrate a strong technical grasp of software solutions, system integrations, workflows, APIs, cloud technologies, and business applications.
  • You analyze customer business processes and translate them into clear technical and solution concepts.
  • You plan and deliver product demonstrations, proofs of concept, and technical workshops that drive measurable outcomes.
  • You are hands-on with technology, possess strong computer skills, and confidently demonstrate software to diverse audiences.
  • You collaborate effectively with Sales, Professional Services, and technical implementation teams to keep opportunities moving.
  • You combine entrepreneurial thinking with a strong, customer-centric mindset.
  • You communicate fluently in English (spoken and written); German fluency is a plus.


What we can offer

What we can offer:

There are many great reasons to join DocuWare - our company culture is only one of them.
 As part of the DocuWare team, you will benefit from many advantages:

  • Globally distributed, international teams: You will find our teams working in Germering, New York, Sofia or other worldwide locations.
  • Flexible work location and hours: You can work on the road or in our modern office - and you have the flexibility to arrange your own working hours.
  • Individual support: After an intensive induction, you will receive regular training tailored to your needs (e.g. conferences internal team building measures).
  • Well-earned rest: 35 vacation days per year, sport offerings, massages, a football table and a relaxing lounge area.
  • Healthy food: Together we enjoy Fairtrade coffee with organic milk or oat milk, snacks and fresh fruit - all free of charge - as well as subsidized lunch from the Foodji fridge.
  • Mental health support: With our employee assistance program you have free and confidential access to resources and support for your well-being and stress management at any time.
  • Good accessibility: Choose how you would like to come to the office with a leased e-bike, by train or via highways A96/A99 (you can charge your e-car on site for free).
  • Team spirit: Regular employee and team events (virtual or on-site) ensure excellent collaboration with colleagues around the world.
  • Sustainability and social commitment: DocuWare stands for paperless work and supports volunteer organizations and local sports clubs.
  • Your health matters: DocuWare subsidizes your company pension plan!
  • Lastly, and most importantly, we offer a stable job with a well established and growing company.
  • Unique benefits: Choose one of three great options (Bonago, E-Gym or subsidized Deutschlandticket) to suit your needs.
  • We only use the latest technologies - find out more on Stackshare.
  • 30 Days Work from Abroad: Experience international opportunities and broaden your horizons.
  • Family First: Preferred enrollment in our selected daycare center in Germering (no guarantee).
  • Buddy Program: You'll be paired with a buddy, who will support you during your onboarding and offer valuable tips.
  • For better insights, check us out on Instagram!


Your hiring partner

Lea Thanner
Recruiting & Employer Branding Specialist

title: Head of Business Operations / Senior Business Operations Manager - all genders welcome!
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Vicegolf
description_html:
About the Job

Join us in reshaping the future of golf! With a team of over 85 passionate people, we're dedicated to our mission in revolutionizing the golf industry one swing at a time. Our international team, based in Munich, is seeking a motivated Head of Business Operations or Senior Business Operations Manager to become part of our company in a dynamic and innovative environment. In this role, you help translate our revenue targets into an operational plan and bring five independent teams together along this plan. You are the central interface for planning, timing, and alignment in the revenue and marketing area, holding everything together. Ready to embrace your Vice?


Skip the copy paste. Show us your swing

Your CV tells us what you’ve done. We want to understand why those experiences make you the right person for this role. So make your application your own: tailor your CV, tell us about your most relevant achievement, or surprise us with a short presentation. This isn’t a design contest, we’re interested in how you think, what you bring to the table, and what you want to achieve at Vice.


Your Fairway

  • Break down monthly and quarterly D2C targets into weekly and daily targets with specific references to products and promotional campaigns
  • Develop target proposals for C-level executives, who will approve the final plan
  • Maintain the product and promotional calendar, taking processes and deadlines into account
  • Ensuring lead times across five teams (E-commerce & UX, CRM, Performance Marketing, Brand & Marketing, Tech) and identifying and resolving deviations early on
  • Leading the weekly trading review
  • Analyzing problems and developing solutions together with the teams
  • Supporting the expansion of planning to additional sales channels (Green Grass, Specialty Retail, Amazon, etc.)
  • Making independent decisions regarding promotional calendars, discounts, and team prioritization; final decisions regarding budget, pricing, and P&L remain the responsibility of our C-level


Your Scorecard

  • Commercial numerical understanding and judgment rather than pure reporting of numbers

  • Fluency in spoken and written German and English

  • Several years of professional experience (3+ years) in business operations, consulting, chief of staff, commercial, and program management, or comparable experience in complex organizational areas is preferred

  • A background in performance marketing, content, or e-commerce technology is an asset but not a requirement

  • Organizational talent to bring five teams together, identify dependencies early on, and ensure alignment before a gap turns into a problem

  • Critical mindset to challenge the status quo, contribute your own ideas, and actively help shape the future rather than just following plans

  • Structured thinking with foresight

  • Strong communication skills to convince experienced team leads on an equal footing and think creatively with them about the future, while still giving them the space to apply their technical expertise

  • A passion for golf is a plus, but not a requirement 


Note: We use Artificial Intelligence to support this process; the final decision still remains with a human.


Our Clubhouse

  • We embrace diversity and innovation. Our motley team comes from all backgrounds and perspectives, united by fresh and bold ideas.

  • Taking ownership from day one. Our ambitious vision relies on every individual stepping up to bring Vice Golf to the next level.

  • Make your work hours fit your life. Flexible work arrangements and remote work options cater to your work-life balance.

  • Grow with us. We place great emphasis on your personal development, where you benefit from not only regular performance feedback but also an annual training budget.

  • Escape the routine. Within the EU, you’re free to choose your workspace for two weeks a year.

  • Stay active. We’re invested in your well-being, subsidizing EGYM Wellpass so you can train for only 30 € a month.

  • Enjoy! Fuel your day with a varied selection of fresh meals and snacks from our Foodji.

  • Secure your (far) future! While retirement might seem distant to you, we’ve got you covered with options to enroll in our corporate pension plan.

  • Work hard play hard. Work on your golf skills and refine your swing on the state-of-the-art golf simulator and putting green in our office.

  • Enjoy the open bar. Have some Afterwork drinks on our rooftop while enjoying the view of the Alps.

title: Product Owner (all genders) - Management Suite Tribe
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Baramundi Software Ag
description_html:
Welcome to baramundi!

“Where security, automation and centralized control come together, modern endpoint management begins.”

Do you want to actively shape modern UEM solutions, translate technical complexity into clear product decisions and create real value for IT administrators together with strong development teams? Then become part of our Management Suite Tribe and help drive the further development of our primarily on-premise Unified Endpoint Management solution as a Product Owner.

At baramundi, we develop software solutions that enable companies to centrally manage, secure and automate their endpoints. As a Product Owner, you work closely with development, Product Management, Support, Consulting and our customers in an agile, interdisciplinary environment. Your goal: to translate product requirements into valuable, prioritized and actionable features.


Do what you do best:

  • DRIVE PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT IN THE MANAGEMENT SUITE TRIBE You take content responsibility for two development squads and, together with them, further develop key product areas of the baramundi Management Suite, primarily in Windows Endpoint Management – from fundamental client-server communication to compliance and defense management, Windows OS installation, co-management and Windows Update Management. You are part of the Product Owner Chapter and work closely within the leadership trio of Chapter Lead, Scrum Master and Product Owner.
  • TRANSLATE REQUIREMENTS INTO CLEAR PRODUCT INCREMENTS You understand technical and functional complexity, formulate features and product backlog items precisely and ensure clear, testable acceptance criteria. You prioritize the product backlog based on customer value, effort, dependencies and stakeholder input.
  • DELIVER WITH YOUR TEAMS You are the primary contact person for content-related and product-related questions from your development teams, make progress transparent and ensure that your squads can work in a focused, informed and empowered way. At the same time, you balance maintenance, quality and new features.
  • BE THE BRIDGE BETWEEN PRODUCT, DEVELOPMENT AND STAKEHOLDERS You work closely with Product Management, Support, Consulting, customers as well as internal and external development partners, actively gather feedback and translate requirements into concrete development steps. In doing so, you represent product value just as clearly as the perspective of your teams.
  • COORDINATE EXTERNAL PROJECTS AND DEVELOPMENT SERVICES You coordinate external teams and projects from a content perspective, ensure clear requirements, transparent alignment and reliable integration into product development.
  • USE AI MEANINGFULLY IN YOUR PRODUCT OWNER ROUTINE You use AI tools in a reflective and pragmatic way – for example when creating features and PBIs, structuring requirements or developing quick prototypes for stakeholder feedback.


What we appreciate about you:

  • Several years of experience as a Product Owner or in a comparable role with product responsibility in an agile software development environment.
  • Experience in providing content leadership for multiple development teams as well as integrating and coordinating external projects or developers.
  • Confidence working with Scrum, Kanban and backlog tools – ideally Azure DevOps – as well as experience in scaled agile ways of working.
  • Solid knowledge of or strong interest in Unified Endpoint Management, Client Lifecycle Management and Windows-based IT infrastructures.
  • Ability to quickly understand technical complexity and translate it into clear, prioritizable requirements.
  • Analytical, data-based decision-making and a high standard of quality.
  • Strong communication skills in German and English and enjoyment in working with different stakeholders.
  • Ability to provide content leadership at eye level, create orientation and foster open, transparent exchange within the team.
  • Bonus: background in IT administration, practical knowledge of software development, experience with the Azure technology stack or touchpoints with Linux, macOS, Android or iOS.


Meet us!


10 reasons to choose baramundi!

#1 ARRIVE IN PEACE
Our all-inclusive package makes starting particularly easy. Your personal onboarding buddy will show you everything: from the welcome breakfast to the fully equipped workplace.

#2 FEEL AT HOME
Coffee, fruit, and drinks are free. We take care of your mail and packages. Once a month, all baramundians meet during work hours for pizza and chatting. Just because.

#3 EXPERIENCE VALUE AND APPRECIATION
We believe in values and live them: togetherness and trust. Courage, enthusiasm, and competence. Our communication culture is open and honest. Just like the regular team feedback sessions.

#4 GET REWARDED
You will also feel our appreciation. Success bonuses are as natural as Christmas bonuses, company pension plans, and team events.

#5 ENJOY LIFE
Work time is life time. That’s why you can organize it individually with us. With flexible working hours in full or part-time, home office, and even sabbatical options.

#6 STAY HEALTHY
We want you to feel good. That’s why we have ergonomic furniture and organize health days, massages, yoga, and running groups.

#7 DEVELOP FURTHER
Your personal and professional advancement is important to us. We pay for training and coaching during working hours. Even two-year work stays at our branch in the USA are possible.

#8 WORK AT EYE LEVEL
We are all on a first-name basis, from apprentices to management. We don’t have complicated hierarchies.

#9 YOUR FAMILY IS IMPORTANT TO US
Family means being there, caring, and supporting each other. We do this with daycare subsidies and holiday care, as well as at our family summer festival.

#10 MAKE US EVEN BETTER
We want to be a great place and employer. For that, we need honest feedback.


Contact us!

title: Account Executive/Sales (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Hive Robotics
description_html:
Role

Hive Robotics is building Europe’s first full-stack orchestration platform for unmanned systems: connecting, controlling, and commanding multi-vendor drone and robot swarms. Our RF communication systems are Made in Germany, deployed on active frontlines, and targeting a highly valued tactical communication market with zero sovereign alternatives today.
As our first dedicated Account Executive, you own the sales pipeline: every opportunity from a lead to a signed contract. You take over our existing customer accounts and drive the opportunities our founders and Business Development have opened, with the first new deals expected to close within 3 months. You currently report to the CEO.
This role is customer-facing by design: expect 30–50% travel to customer sites, procurement offices, partners and trade fairs across Germany and Europe, sometimes internationally. The rest of the time you work alongside Engineering, Product Management and our Field Application Engineers.


Responsibilities

  • Own the funnel from the first qualified conversation to signature. Our founders and Business Development open doors with customers, partners and the wider ecosystem. From there the opportunity is yours: you qualify it, drive it and close it, pulling the founders back in only when a deal needs them. Leads you generate yourself count just as much, this isn't exclusively BD's territory.
  • Qualify hard and early. Run discovery against a fixed gate (pain, budget, decision-making unit, timing) before we invest engineering time in a technical deep dive, and keep a clear next step with a date on every opportunity.
  • Lead the customer's buying team through a hardware buying cycle: end users, engineers, procurement, legal and IT, across long evaluations, equipment trials run as projects, integration questions and security reviews.
  • Orchestrate the deal team. Bring in our engineers and Field Application Engineers for demos, trials and technical deep dives, and Product Management for configuration and fit. You decide when a deal needs them and what they're there to do.
  • Own our active customers commercially: account plans, follow-on orders, upsells and expansion into new units and use cases, every escalation that touches the relationship, and regular account reviews with the Field Application Engineer who owns adoption.
  • Turn deployed systems into the next deal: reference visits, customer quotes and case material that you or the founders can use to open new accounts.
  • Own the offer: configuration and pricing, terms and conditions, the cost-benefit case on the customer's own data, and the project plan to signature. Lead our responses to RFPs and tenders where they apply, and build the templates so every proposal starts from a proven base.
  • Get a trial agreement signed before any trial starts: scope, duration, success criteria, pilot price and the path to the main contract. You drive it, Operations owns the paperwork.
  • Close, and hand over cleanly. Request the contract from Operations, keep the customer and the internal side moving, and sign. Then hand over to Operations as a confirmed customer order and to the Field Application Engineer for onboarding.
  • Keep the pipeline honest: stage discipline, forecast and CRM hygiene, and a weekly pipeline review you run for the founders


Requirements

Must Have

  • 7+ years in B2B sales of technical products into complex, multi-stakeholder deals, ideally in a scale up company
  • You have sold hardware, or hardware combined with software and firmware: physical systems with configurations, lead times, integration work and delivery commitments behind them
  • Comfortable selling to technical and non-technical stakeholders in the same room, and knowing when to bring in the engineers
  • Hands-on daily work in a CRM and a disciplined qualification method (e.g. MEDDPICC): your forecast is something the company can plan on
  • Closer's mindset: you treat an opportunity without a next step and a date as a problem, not a pipeline entry
  • Structured working style: your offers, decisions and customer commitments are written down so that Operations, the field team and the founders can act on them without asking
  • Willingness to travel 30–50 % across Germany and Europe, occasionally beyond Europe
  • Fluent English (German is a very big plus)
  • Eligibility and willingness to undergo security vetting for access to some customer sites
Nice to Have
  • An existing network or experience selling to the DACH defense ecosystem: armed forces, procurement offices, primes, integrators
  • Technical fluency in RF communication, embedded systems, unmanned systems, command-and-control or robotics
  • Experience building a sales pipeline or sales function from scratch rather than inheriting one

title: Creative (Motion Design)
description_html:
Superside is looking for a motion designer with the creativity, technical expertise, and innovation mindset to push the boundaries of motion design. You’ll work with top global brands, crafting high-impact motion graphics, animated digital ads, Lottie animations, and more, all while collaborating with a world-class, globally distributed team of creatives.

This is a high-ownership role where you’ll contribute to cutting-edge projects, explore new animation technologies, and help shape Superside’s creative motion capabilities.

What you'll do

  • Design engaging motion graphics for leading global brands across various formats.
  • Collaborate with dedicated account teams across different time zones.
  • Work on a number of simultaneous projects, executed with high attention to detail, on time and budget.
  • Support creative leads to help our customers achieve goals and add business value through design.
  • Take ownership of technical motion innovations, including Rive and Lottie animations.
  • Explore and integrate AI-powered tools for video, image generation, and animation enhancements.
  • Work on interactive motion projects that push the limits of storytelling and engagement.

What you will need to succeed

  • BA or higher in Design, Creative, Communications, or a related field.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing motion design, animation, and video expertise.
  • Mastery of After Effects, Illustrator, and Photoshop (3D and video editing a plus).
  • Experience working with Rive and Lottie animations.
  • Deep understanding of animation principles and visual storytelling.
  • Ability to always deliver pixel-perfect quality on time and within budget.
  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills.
  • Familiarity with AI-enhanced motion tools and emerging creative tech.
  • Knowledge of working with UI design systems.
  • Preferably some understanding of HTML5.

Compensation

Additional Information

Why Join us?

Superside's vision is to create equal opportunities globally by accelerating the world’s transition to online work. With that in mind, we're building a fully remote company that attracts people where they are.

Remote-first. Customer-led.

Remote isn’t just a perk; it’s how we deliver better for customers. We are fully committing to our customers by hiring top talent and collaborating seamlessly across time zones.

Global team, local impact.

Join a community of 60+ nationalities working across time zones, cultures, and disciplines, all aligned on doing great work for great brands.

High performance, low ego.

Work in a fast-paced, high-trust environment where feedback is direct, growth is constant, and kindness leads collaboration.

Impact meets opportunity.

We’re in the sweet spot — big enough to be stable, small enough for you to shape what’s next. Your ideas will matter here.

Grow fast. Lead well.

You’ll gain mentorship, take on real responsibility, and grow your career while helping us disrupt a global industry.

About Superside

Superside is the leading AI-powered creative company that quickly and cost-effectively enhances in-house functions. We help over 500 ambitious brands get great creative concepts done at scale. Built to be an extension

of in-house teams, we unbottleneck marketing and creative teams so they can move faster and drive more reliable creative performance.

Superside is a fully remote company with over 700 team members working across 60+ countries and 13 timezones.

Learn more at superside.com

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We’re an equal-opportunity company. All applicants will be considered regardless of ethnicity, appearance, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, veteran or disability status.

title: Associate General Counsel, Litigation
description_html:
Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About the Role:

We are looking for an experienced Associate General Counsel, Litigation to join our fun, mission-driven, growth-focused team to lead litigation strategy at the intersection of technology, the law, and Motive’s business objectives. The legal team’s mission is to mitigate risk while maximizing growth and our vision is to be trusted advisors to the business. We succeed when employees know when to seek legal advice and integrate legal advice, counsel, and review into the company’s initiatives so they succeed.

This role will manage Motive's litigation function with emphasis on building, executing and advancing our litigation strategy, partnering closely with legal and business leadership. This is a high-impact leadership role for an attorney who leads with a proactive mindset, operates strategically and tactically, and can build a litigation function that scales with the company.

You’ll serve as a senior day-to-day leader for litigation matters across the company while collaborating closely with internal stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Sales, Security, Finance, and other relevant teams.

What You'll Do:

  • Develop a deep understanding of Motive's products, work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales, Security, and Finance, and earn the trust of leadership as a go-to advisor on contentious and strategic matters
  • Develop and drive Motive’s litigation strategy, including identifying, assessing and pursuing claims, counterclaims, and other strategic litigation opportunities that protect Motive and advance its business objectives
  • Manage and develop litigation team members and help shape the structure, priorities, and operating model of the litigation function
  • Lead outside counsel selection, strategy, matter staffing, and budget management across litigation matters
  • Stay up to date on industry developments to help your colleagues see around corners

What We're Looking For:

  • US-licensed attorney with 10+ years of relevant litigation experience, with significant time at a top-tier litigation firm. In-house experience at a high-growth technology company a plus
  • Expertise in initiating and leading complex IP, trade secret, marketing, Lanham and competitor-related disputes, with a demonstrated track record of wins
  • Significant trial experience, including dispositive motions, witness examination, and argument
  • Expertise developing litigation strategy across all phases, including pre-suit assessment, TRO and preliminary injunction practice, pleadings, discovery, motion practice, trial, settlement, and appeal
  • Experience in litigation for a public company, including financial reporting, audit, and governance
  • Experience managing outside counsel, litigation budgets, and cross-functional internal teams
  • Willing to roll up your sleeves and do what needs doing
  • Humble, low ego, deep commitment to empowering your colleagues
  • Strong judgment, executive presence, and ability to influence stakeholders across the business
  • AI-first perspective, with interest in building and leveraging AI-driven tools
  • Note: This individual will work a hybrid schedule in-office (2 days a week), if within the Bay Area.

Pay Transparency
Your compensation may be based on several factors, including education, work experience, and certifications. For certain roles, total compensation may include restricted stock units. Motive offers benefits including health, pharmacy, optical and dental care benefits, paid time off, sick time off, short term and long term disability coverage, life insurance as well as 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). Learn more about our benefits by visiting Motive Perks & Benefits.

The compensation range for this position will depend on where you reside. Motive uses three geographic zones to determine pay range. For this role, the compensation ranges are:

San Francisco, California

$270,000—$372,000 USD

U.S. metropolitan areas: Los Angeles, San Diego, New York City Area, Seattle, Washington D.C.

$235,000—$323,000 USD

Other locations in the United States

$235,000—$323,000 USD

Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace is one of Motive's core values. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.

Please review our Candidate Privacy Notice here.

UK Candidate Privacy Notice here.

The applicant must be authorized to receive and access those commodities and technologies controlled under U.S. Export Administration Regulations. It is Motive's policy to require that employees be authorized to receive access to Motive products and technology.

All job postings are for existing vacancies. Please note; some interviews or new-hire training sessions may be held in person at one of our global offices.

As a Strategic Enterprise Account Executive at Databricks, you are a sales professional experienced in leading go-to-market campaigns in Fortune 500 accounts. As we continue our rapid expansion, we are looking for a creative, execution-oriented Strat Enterprise Account Executive - TTH vertical to join the Databricks team and maximize the phenomenal market opportunity that exists for DatabricksReporting to our Director, Enterprise you will map to a strategic customer. What we look for:

  • You have previously excelled in an early-stage company -- you know how to navigate and be successful with limited oversight
  • Previous field sales experience within AI/BI, big data, Cloud, SaaS, and a consumption selling motion
  • Prior customer relationships with CIOs, program managers, and essential decision makers at local accounts

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About the Role:

As an Enterprise Account Executive at Motive, you are responsible for developing and closing business with Motive’s largest prospects. You will sell into the most impactful companies in North America that power the physical economy. We are seizing the opportunity created by our strong product positioning in the market by heavily investing across all Go-To-Market (GTM) teams within our Enterprise segment. You will lead the charge, selling the value of our products and the business outcomes that can be achieved in partnership with Motive.

Our Enterprise Account Executives sell across multiple industries, including trucking, oil & gas, construction, agriculture, manufacturing, consumer transit, or any other business that requires a fleet of vehicles. You are receptive to feedback, have a willingness to learn, a strong technical aptitude, and a high attention to detail. Because of the collaborative nature of our Go-to-Market team, a win-as-a-team mentality is a must. In this high-energy role, you should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with high standards of quality.

Territory: Texas (Texas, Arkansas, Louisiana, New Mexico and Oklahoma; must be located in one of these states)

What you’ll do:

  • Prospect and win new Enterprise business through developing key executive relationships within key prospects to drive expansion of that business with all key accounts, growing share of wallet through developing a deep understanding of each client’s business and identifying opportunities for additional collaboration
  • Harness key Executive relationships to ensure RFP wins and grow contractual-based business
  • Partner with the balance of your account team and leverage customer analytics and other available resources to optimize buying decisions
  • Resolve problems, including identifying issues, thinking critically to determine the optimal course of action, and implementing best available solutions
  • Work with technical resources to display to prospects the power of integrations & how our partner ecosystem increases the value of our hardware and software
  • Effectively plan to meet and exceed your ongoing business goals and revenue quotas
  • Develop a deep understanding of our technology platform and operations, using that understanding and market input to bring back iterations to our business
  • Constantly study and deepen understanding of market trends to enable consultative insight

About you:

    • You have deep Enterprise sales experience partnering with F1000 clients
    • You're a true hunter driven to win new logos and build business from the ground up
      • 5+ years of SaaS or industry relevant Enterprise field sales experience required
    • You show a strong track record of exceeding quotas and rapidly growing your book over time backed up by data
    • You have an ability to build rapport with executive decision-makers, influencing outcomes through both an understanding of the customer’s business and the unique solutions that Motive can deliver
    • You show a history of working independently with a data-driven mindset for charting a path to short, medium, and long-term sales goals
    • You have best-in-class communication skills, with the ability to successfully convey key value propositions and quick manage objections

title: Account Development Representative - France
description_html:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive.

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business, generating opportunities via outbound outreach.

We have offices in Paris and London and we offer remote working from Germany, France and the United Kingdom.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, and the United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara’s mission.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and LinkedIn
  • Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.
  • Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling
  • Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles
  • 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum
  • Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
  • Curious and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and in French

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in closing-sales roles
  • Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a “win as a team” environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space

ADR pathways

Through Samsara’s ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs’ understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.

  • ADR I representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.
  • The next level in the program is ADR II, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.
  • The highest level within our organization is ADR III. These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Creative (Graphic Designer)
description_html:
Superside is looking for a talented Graphic Designer to join our global creative team. You'll create standout visual work for some of the world's most ambitious brands: from brand identity and campaign design to digital and social assets. You’ll be working alongside creative leads, project managers, and clients across a wide range of industries.

This is a hands-on design role built for the way design actually gets made today. You'll spend most of your time designing, building concepts, refining visual systems, and pushing craft, using today's leading AI creative tools as a core part of your process, not an afterthought. We're looking for designers who already treat tools & models like Flora, Krea, Figma AI, Claude, NanoBanana, GPT Image, and Seedance as part of their everyday kit, and who know when to reach for them and when strong traditional craft is what the work actually needs.

What you’ll do

  • Design across branding, campaigns, and digital platforms: logos, visual identity systems, social and display content, presentations, web and landing pages, and more.
  • Use generative AI tools & models (e.g. Flora, Krea, Figma AI, Claude, NanoBanana, GPT Image, Seedance, etc.) throughout your process: concepting, ideation, image generation, layout exploration, and production to move faster without sacrificing craft.
  • Translate creative briefs into polished, on-brand visual concepts, iterating based on feedback from creative leads and clients.
  • Maintain and evolve visual identity systems, ensuring consistency across deliverables and touchpoints.
  • Apply strong fundamentals such as typography, layout, color, and composition to produce work that is both conceptually sharp and production-ready.
  • Know where AI-assisted output needs a human hand to protect brand integrity, craft quality, and emotional resonance, and refine accordingly.
  • Collaborate closely with Creative Leads, Project Managers, and fellow designers across multiple concurrent projects and accounts.
  • Give and receive constructive creative feedback in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Stay current on new AI tools and workflows as they emerge, and share techniques and learnings with the wider design team.
  • Manage your time and priorities across multiple projects, meeting deadlines without sacrificing quality.

What you’ll bring

  • 4+ years of experience as a designer, with a portfolio that demonstrates strong conceptual thinking and visual craft across brand, campaign, and digital work.
  • Hands-on, current experience with generative AI creative tools & models like Flora, Krea, Figma AI, Claude, NanoBanana, GPT Image, Seedance, etc as a required, everyday part of your workflow, not a nice-to-have.
  • Deep proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and Figma.
  • Solid grounding in design fundamentals: typography, layout, color theory, and visual hierarchy.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to interpret briefs and explain design decisions clearly.
  • A collaborative mindset, comfortable giving and receiving feedback, and working across distributed, cross-functional teams.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Self-motivation and comfort working independently in a remote-first environment.

Compensation

Additional Information

Why Join us?

Superside's vision is to create equal opportunities globally by accelerating the world’s transition to online work. With that in mind, we're building a fully remote company that attracts people where they are.

Remote-first. Customer-led.

Remote isn’t just a perk; it’s how we deliver better for customers. We are fully committing to our customers by hiring top talent and collaborating seamlessly across time zones.

Global team, local impact.

Join a community of 60+ nationalities working across time zones, cultures, and disciplines, all aligned on doing great work for great brands.

High performance, low ego.

Work in a fast-paced, high-trust environment where feedback is direct, growth is constant, and kindness leads collaboration.

Impact meets opportunity.

We’re in the sweet spot — big enough to be stable, small enough for you to shape what’s next. Your ideas will matter here.

Grow fast. Lead well.

You’ll gain mentorship, take on real responsibility, and grow your career while helping us disrupt a global industry.

About Superside

Superside is the leading AI-powered creative company that quickly and cost-effectively enhances in-house functions. We help over 500 ambitious brands get great creative concepts done at scale. Built to be an extension

of in-house teams, we unbottleneck marketing and creative teams so they can move faster and drive more reliable creative performance.

Superside is a fully remote company with over 700 team members working across 60+ countries and 13 timezones.

Learn more at superside.com

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We’re an equal-opportunity company. All applicants will be considered regardless of ethnicity, appearance, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, veteran or disability status.

title: Psychiatrist (Part-Time) - Contract
description_html:
About the Psychiatrist, Part-Time (Contract) role with Headspace:

Headspace is your lifelong guide to better mental health. We make mental health support accessible to everyone, no matter their background or experience. Through our flagship Headspace app, we provide mindfulness tools for everyday life, including meditations, sleepcasts, mindful movement and focus exercises. Our enterprise offerings combine this experience with a human-centered model of care, with coaching, therapy, psychiatry and EAP services under one roof. Our team of experts ranges from mental health clinicians, to Emmy award-winning producers and data scientists, working together as one to help millions of people around the world be healthier and more productive.

Members who have access to our personalized care plans receive the right level of care based on their needs - from self-management tools and coaching to therapy and psychiatry. Our proprietary app delivers clinically validated self-care content, along with chat access to coaches and video access to therapists, psychiatrists for our members.In moments of need, we provide our members with stigma-free access to high-quality coaches, clinicians and content.

We are currently seeking an IMLCC eligible 1099 licensed psychiatrist contractor to provide direct, virtual care as part of a multidisciplinary team. Psychiatrists will provide care only to members who reside in states in which the clinician is licensed.

The hourly rate range for this role is $185 -195 /per session. Pay rate is determined by a number of factors, including but not limited to location, skills and scope required, relevant licensure and certifications, and unique relevant experience and job-related skills.

Contractors are expected to provide a minimum 10 hours a week of availability. More is always welcome, depending on your schedule.

Due to the nature of healthcare services provided to our customers, partners and members, all work must be provided in the U.S. Data, specifically personal health information, may not be accessed, disclosed or used outside of the U.S. Please note that the U.S. is limited to the 50 states of the United States -- it does not include U.S. territories like Puerto Rico.

***Preference will be given to providers who are ILMCC Eligible.***

What you will do

Direct Care

  • Provide high quality, innovative, tele-psychiatry to Headspace patients over a HIPAA-compliant video conferencing platform
  • Complete, sign and lock clinical case notes within 24 hours of session
  • Maintain your personalized database to record proof of licensure, license updates, expiration dates, personal information, etc.
  • Stay up to date with clinical leadership communication (checking and responding to emails in a timely fashion)
  • Work with a collaborative care team including mental health coaches, other therapists, psychiatric nurse practitioners, and external care providers

Required Background

  • Must be available for at least 10 hours per week
    • Night and weekend flexibility is a plus
  • MD with completion of accredited psychiatry residency - BE/BC
  • A license to practice psychiatry
  • Licensure in multiple states is highly valued, specifically MUST be IMLCC eligible
  • Cross licensed and/or willing to cross license in multiple full scope of practice states
  • 3+ years experience providing clinical psychiatry services
  • Experience with tele-psychiatry highly valued
  • Willingness and confidence to integrate cutting-edge technology into all aspects of your care
  • Clinical competence in psychopharmacology and in evidence based practices (CBT, DBT, ACT, Mindfulness, etc.)
  • Knowledge of current research to integrate into your practice
  • Familiarity, comfort and confidence with technology - various applications, tech tools, Google web-apps, video conferencing, EMR, etc.
  • **Tech-savviness is a must**

Headspace participates in the E-Verify Program.

Privacy Statement

All member records are protected according to our Privacy Policy. Further, while employees of Headspace (formerly Ginger) cannot access Headspace products/services, they will be offered benefits according to the company's benefit plan. To ensure we are adhering to best practice and ethical guidelines in the field of mental health, we take care to avoid dual relationships. A dual relationship occurs when a mental health care provider has a second, significantly different relationship with their client in addition to the traditional client-therapist relationship—including, for example, a managerial relationship.

As such, Headspace requests that individuals who have received coaching or clinical services at Headspace wait until their care with Headspace is complete before applying for a position. If someone with a Headspace account is hired for a position, please note their account will be deactivated and they will not be able to use Headspace services for the duration of their employment.

Further, if Headspace cannot find a role that fails to resolve an ethical issue associated with a dual relationship, Headspace may need to take steps to ensure ethical obligations are being adhered to, including a delayed start date or a potential leave of absence. Such steps would be taken to protect both the former member, as well as any relevant individuals from their care team, from impairment, risk of exploitation, or harm.

For how how we will use the personal information you provide as part of the application process, please see: https://organizations.headspace.com/page/applicant-notice.

About the Remote Licensed Therapist (1099 Contractor) role at Headspace:

Headspace is currently seeking part-time, independently licensed contractor therapists to provide direct, virtual care as part of a multidisciplinary team on a 1099 contract basis.

To get started, we strongly encourage having 10+ hours available per week with full flexibility to adjust; more is always welcome depending on your schedule! Please note that due to care demand and member scheduling fluctuations, it could take a number of weeks to achieve a consistent schedule.

The pay range for the Contract Mental Health Therapist ranges from $69-$74 per teletherapy session. Exact reimbursement rates will be determined during the interview process and are based on a number of factors including but not limited to location, licensure type, experience, specializations, languages spoken, and populations treated.

Session length is 60 minutes for an intake and 45 minutes for a follow up appointment, with concurrent note-taking expected and included in the session rate. All Headspace therapists must be licensed and reside in the US. Our education program promotes continuous skill development, improving your clinical expertise while expanding your knowledge and capabilities.

  • 3+ years experience providing clinical psychotherapy to individuals, couples or families

  • Experience with risk management and higher acuity cases
  • Knowledge, ability, and commitment to providing culturally responsive care
  • Familiarity, comfort and confidence with care delivery technology - various applications, tech tools, google web-apps, video conferencing, EMR, etc.
  • A safe secure location with reliable internet connection to provide Zoom-based psychotherapy
  • Effective communication skills and ability to work within interdisciplinary teams

Preferred (if applicable)

  • Licensure in multiple states
  • Licensed psychologist with willingness to apply for (or is already enrolled) with PSYPACT
  • Ability to deliver care to a variety of populations
  • Multilingual
  • Familiarity with the Headspace app and content
  • Willingness to include evening availability in your schedule to support member care flexibility

title: Junior Software Engineer (m/w/d) — KI-gestützte Entwicklung
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at data nation GmbH
description_html:
Standort: Alstertwiete 3, 20099 Hamburg

Über uns:
data nation bringt frischen Wind in die Fitnessbranche durch innovative Digitalisierungs- und Automatisierungsansätze. Unser Ziel ist es, durch kreative Lösungen messbare Erfolge zu erzielen und Standards neu zu definieren. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2021 durch Bruno To-Vinh sind Flexibilität, Offenheit, Kundenfokus, Integrität und Verantwortung die Säulen unserer Unternehmenskultur.

Mit Gymcubator haben wir unser eigenes Produkt entwickelt: eine KI-Plattform für Fitnessstudios, die mit Mitgliedern über WhatsApp und E-Mail kommuniziert, Buchungen und Anfragen verwaltet und Studio-Teams im Alltag unterstützt. Dutzende Studios nutzen das System bereits täglich in Production – und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel: Für die Weiterentwicklung von Gymcubator suchen wir Verstärkung.

Deine Rolle:

Du startest dort, wo man ein Produkt wirklich kennenlernt: beim Onboarding neuer Kunden, im Production Support und beim Beheben von Fehlern. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Gründer und wächst Schritt für Schritt in eine vollwertige Entwicklerrolle hinein.

Wir setzen KI-Agenten in allen Phasen der Entwicklung ein. Du lernst dabei nicht nur, mit KI schnell Code zu schreiben — du verstehst am Ende wirklich, wie verteilte Systeme in Production gebaut und betrieben werden: moderne Architekturen, Cloud, CI/CD und agentische Systeme.


Deine Aufgaben:

  • ⁠Neue Fitnessstudios onboarden: Einrichtung, Konfiguration, Integrationen

  • ⁠Wiederkehrende Aufgaben im Onboarding automatisieren und den Prozess Schritt für Schritt skalierbar machen

  • ⁠Production Support: Probleme mit Code, Logs und Daten untersuchen und beheben

  • ⁠Bugfixes und kleinere Features umsetzen, testen und releasen

  • ⁠Mitarbeit an Cloud-Infrastruktur und CI/CD-Pipeline: Deployments, Kubernetes, Monitoring

  • ⁠Lernen, KI-Agenten zu steuern und generierten Code kritisch zu prüfen

  • ⁠Mit wachsender Erfahrung: eigenständige Entwicklung von Features

Was wir bieten:

  • ⁠Mentoring direkt durch den Gründer und praxisnahe Ausbildung in KI-gestützter Entwicklung

  • Ein echtes Verständnis dafür, wie verteilte Production-Systeme mit zahlenden Kunden gebaut und betrieben werden: moderne Architekturen, Cloud, CI/CD und agentische Systeme

  • ⁠Klarer Wachstumspfad vom Support in die Produktentwicklung

  • Vollzeitstelle in Deutschland


Bewerbungsprozess: Fühlst Du Dich angesprochen? Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung inklusive Lebenslauf und relevanten Zeugnissen. Bitte sende Deine Unterlagen per E-Mail an ----- Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen und mehr über Deine Motivation und Deine Fähigkeiten zu erfahren.



Wen wir suchen

  • Absolvent:in (Bachelor/Master in Informatik o. ä.) oder vergleichbare Ausbildung mit starkem Portfolio

  • Solide Programmiergrundlagen; Uni-, Praktikums- oder private Projekte zählen

  • Sorgfalt, Neugier und Offenheit für Feedback

  • Fließendes Deutsch (unsere Kunden sind deutsche Fitnessstudios), gutes Englisch

Unser Stack: Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, LangGraph, React, TypeScript, Twilio, Kubernetes — Vorerfahrung damit ist nicht erforderlich.

title: Kaufmännischer Mitarbeiter Qualitätssicherung (m/w/d)
