Similar to how Solutions Architects secure the “technical win” in the sales process, Legal Engineers secure the “legal win” by performing in-depth customer discovery and education on Harvey’s solutions through targeted meetings and demos that resonate with the customer’s day-to-day workflows specific to their legal practice area.

  • Engage with English- and German-speaking lawyers at existing and prospective customers to understand their workflow challenges, strategic objectives, and broader firm context — then demonstrate how Harvey’s AI solutions can address them.

  • Lead product demonstrations tailored to the context of various law firm practice groups and in-house legal teams, asking questions to validate how Harvey can add value and then showcasing Harvey’s features and benefits relevant to each prospective client’s potential use cases.

  • Partner with the marketing team to develop content that will resonate with lawyers, tailored to the unique needs of their practice areas and client types.

  • Act as the “Voice of the Customer,” using your legal perspective to help the broader sales team to develop and implement more effective strategies and synthesize customer feedback for the product team through a legal lens.

  • Tailor the introduction of new solutions to specific customer needs.

  • Further the market perception of Harvey as uniquely credible, substantive, and helpful in applying its AI solutions to make lawyers better at their jobs.

  • Conduct research and analysis on customers and competitors.

  • Executive engagement skills and presence, with an ability to establish strong relationships with key decision makers and build credibility at all levels.

  • Outstanding presentation skills to both legal and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos.

  • Strong understanding of legal processes and challenges faced by legal professionals.

  • Curiosity about AI’s potential to transform the legal industry.

description_html:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

What You’ll Do

Horizon3 is committed to defending businesses from the ever-growing threat landscape. Our advanced solutions and expert team provide unparalleled security for our clients. We are looking for a passionate Sales Engineer to join our team and help prospects and clients understand the true value and capabilities of our product(s) and services.

  • Technical expertise - Must demonstrate deep knowledge of our cybersecurity products and services, assisting the sales team in presenting and position them to prospects and clients.

  • Customer engagement - Must meet with potential customers to understand their cybersecurity needs, challenges, and infrastructure, ensuring that our solutions are the perfect fit for them.

  • Product demonstrations - Provide live demos and proof of concepts for our cybersecurity solutions, tailoring each demo to the specific needs and concerns of the potential customer.

  • Solution development - Will work closely with the sales and product teams to design and refine our solutions based on customer needs.

  • Technical training - train the sales team on the technical aspects of our products to enhance their ability to sell more effectively.

  • Feedback loop - relay feedback from the field to our product and engineering teams, contributing to the ongoing improvement of our product.

  • RFP/RFI assistance - Assist in answering technical sections of RFPs and RFIs.

  • Post-sales support - On rare occasions, assist in post-sales processes to ensure the smooth implementation and satisfaction of our customers.

What You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, cybersecurity, or a related field.

  • Advanced degree(s) are a plus.

  • 5+ years of experience as a Sales Engineer, ideally in the cybersecurity domain.

  • Strong understanding of cyber threats, risk management, and cybersecurity solutions.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Demonstrates ability to simplify complex technical topics for a non-technical audience.

  • Highly collaborative with a strong sense of initiative.

  • Communication skills - Business level German and fluency in English.

Travel Required

This job may require up to 50% of travel to be successful. Job-related travel expenses are reviewed and must be approved by your manager.

Perks of Horizon3

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits.

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

  • Depending on experience, the compensation range for this position is: €160,000 - €190,000 OTE 70/30 split annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. 

Application Note

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

About Eye Security

Eye Security is providing cyber security with embedded cyber insurance solutions for organisations across Europe. Headquartered in the Netherlands, we're over 190 FTEs and growing internationally, having secured Series C funding of 60 million.

We combine cutting-edge technology with hands-on expertise to detect, respond to, and recover from cyber threats in real time. Our team brings together talent from intelligence, military, tech, and consulting backgrounds, all united by one shared mission: to make enterprise-grade cyber security accessible to every business, not just the big players.

At Eye, you'll work on projects with an international footprint, solving real-world challenges and helping to build a safer digital future for our SME clients and our partners.

About this role

We are looking for a Junior Cyber Security Consultant to join our Service Delivery (SD) team, the heart of Eye Security. In this role, you'll be part of a team that guides organisations through their security journey, helping them understand and improve their cyber posture.

You'll execute core tasks within a predefined process: onboarding new customers, supporting them with security questions, delivering periodic cyber-security reviews, and working closely with our technical experts. Your role is hands-on and focused, allowing you to develop real expertise in a structured, supportive environment whilst gradually taking on more responsibility.

Service Delivery sits at the intersection of product, operations, and customers, so you'll work across different teams and grow in multiple aspects of cyber security. This is a strong early-career role with a clear path to grow into more advanced consultant roles over time. You'll solve real problems for real customers, supported by experienced colleagues who want to see you succeed.

What you will do

  • Guide new customers through Eye's onboarding process, helping them implement EDR, cloud monitoring, and other security controls

  • Assess customer security questions and concerns, working out how Eye's resources can best support them

  • Deliver periodic security reviews, providing tailored advice and helping customers understand which measures to prioritise

  • Work closely with our Cyber Security Specialists, Product, Customer Success, Engineering, Security Operations, and Threat Intelligence teams to solve customer challenges

  • Spot opportunities to improve how Eye operates, both technically and in how we build relationships with customers

  • Learn from experienced colleagues and contribute ideas to real projects, taking ownership of well-defined deliverables

  • Support second-line technical challenges alongside our first-line support team and specialists

What you will need

  • Keen interest in cyber security. A formal qualification isn't required, but helpful if you have it

  • Basic understanding of small to medium-sized IT networks and Active Directory

  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive, initiative-driven attitude

  • Strong at working with customers and our partners and take on an advisory role, explaining security concepts in accessible terms

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills

  • Curiosity and willingness to learn across different areas of security

  • Fluency in German and English; other European languages are a bonus

Nice-to-have

  • Experience or exposure to EDR platforms (Crowdstrike) or endpoint security tools

  • Basic familiarity with cloud security concepts or exposure to Azure/Microsoft cloud environments

  • Any relevant security certifications (Security+, CEH) or active study towards one

  • Track record of side projects, open-source contributions, or hands-on security learning (labs, CTFs, personal projects)

  • Experience in technical support or customer-facing technical roles

  • Background in IT networks or systems administration

What we offer

  • A meaningful mission: protect organisations across Europe from real-world cyber threats

  • Work with top-tier professionals from national CERTs, intelligence agencies, and leading tech backgrounds

  • A key role in building an innovative product line combining effective cyber security with cyber insurance

  • A remote-friendly culture with regular meetups and annual company retreats (Spain, Portugal, Italy, Greece and beyond)

  • Flexibility in working hours (Output based)

  • On-Site Thursday socials to stay connected with your team

  • A generous time-off policy, including wellbeing and volunteering days

  • Structured mentorship and clear development pathways as you grow into more senior consultant roles

  • Monthly events, a fun team culture, and real opportunities for career development as Eye scales rapidly

If you're hesitant about applying for this role because you're unsure whether your capabilities match the job requirements, please get in touch, either by email to ----- or via linkedin Daniel Boatman OR Björn Blockhuis, the manager for this role. We're a growing company and might be able to find a way to navigate this together.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to making our hiring process accessible to everyone. If you need a reasonable accommodation to apply or interview for this role, please inform the TA team.

title: Teleoperation Trainer (m/f/d)

description_html:
Who We Are

We build the intelligence that lets robots sense, reason, and act in the real world, moving beyond the lab and into everyday industrial settings like warehouses and factories. Our technology closes the automation gaps that traditional systems can't solve. We are on a mission to redefine how physical work gets done, and we're looking for curious, bold thinkers to help shape the future of robotics with us.

Overview

We are looking for a Teleoperation Trainer to sit at the intersection of our operations and engineering teams. In this role, you will train and quality-manage a team of teleoperation operators, establish and maintain data collection standards, and act as the critical bridge between project management and the technical teams developing our teleoperation and policy systems. You will maintain direct teleoperation proficiency and translate operational insight into actionable engineering feedback, and vice versa. This role starts hands-on and grows in scope and ownership as we scale.

Your Responsibilities

Training & Quality Management

  • Onboard and train new teleoperation operators, establishing consistent standards for task execution, data quality, and reporting

  • Monitor and evaluate operator performance and demonstration data quality across active projects

  • Establish and improve QA processes, and maintain oversight of data custody, tracking, reporting, and issue investigation

  • Develop and maintain SOPs, training materials, and quality frameworks for teleoperation workflows

  • Build and maintain the operational systems, trackers, reporting cadences, and documentation the function runs on

  • Maintain accurate logs of training outcomes, data quality metrics, and cross-team feedback

Cross-Team Coordination

  • Act as the primary bridge between the operations team and the engineering team (teleoperation and policy development), surfacing operator feedback, flagging systematic issues, and translating engineering guidance into practical operator instructions

  • Identify patterns in operator errors, edge cases, and system inconsistencies, and escalate them with structured, actionable context

  • Support engineering teams in improving data collection pipelines and interfaces based on operational insight

Teleoperation

  • Maintain direct proficiency across robotic systems and teleoperation interfaces (VR, joystick, or control rigs)

Qualifications

Education and Experience

  • 2+ years of professional experience in training, QA, operations coordination, or a technical environment

  • Background in a structured, process-driven or fast-paced operational setting

  • No specific educational requirement

Skills

  • Strong communication and documentation skills with the ability to convey technical concepts across technical and non-technical audiences

  • Proven ability to assess quality rigorously and coach others toward consistency

  • Comfortable working with digital tools, interfaces, and data-driven workflows

  • Basic technical understanding sufficient to engage productively with engineering teams

Additional Skills / Nice to Have

  • Direct experience with teleoperation systems, simulation environments, or robotics platforms

  • Familiarity with imitation learning or how demonstration data is used in robot policy training

  • Experience in competitive gaming, esports, or precision controller-based tasks; strong spatial awareness and input consistency are directly applicable

  • Background in data annotation, quality assurance, or structured data collection pipelines

  • Experience with VR systems or immersive digital environments

  • Experience in a startup environment

What We Offer:

  • Wellpass (gym membership)

  • Flexible working hours

  • Option to work from home when needed

  • A motivated team and an open corporate culture

  • Competitive compensation and excellent career development opportunities

title: Field Deployment Engineer (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Sereact GmbH
description_html:
About Us

Sereact is a rapidly growing embodied AI company revolutionizing industrial intelligence. We develop advanced robotics and artificial intelligence solutions that enable robotic systems to sense, reason, and act in real-world warehouse and factory environments — helping businesses streamline operations, increase productivity, and transform physical work.

Role Overview

As a Field Deployment Engineer, you will lead the installation and deployment of our AI-powered robotic systems at customer sites across Europe. This is a dynamic, hands-on engineering role that combines technical leadership with practical implementation to ensure successful system integration in high-automation production environments.

You will plan and coordinate deployments, collaborate closely with internal engineering teams, project managers and customer stakeholders, and take end-to-end responsibility for the complete installation, integration, and commissioning process onsite. This is a hands on role where you will contribute directly to mechanical and electrical work to support live systems, helping install new systems, and troubleshoot robotic systems during on-site deployments.

Your Responsibilities:

Deployment Leadership

  • Lead the installation and commissioning of robotic systems at customer facilities.

  • Coordinate deployments with internal engineering teams, contractors, and customer personnel.

  • Coordinate deployments with internal engineering teams, contractors, and customer personnel.

  • Plan installation workflows and ensure deployments are executed safely and efficiently.

  • Serve as the primary technical contact during on-site deployments.

  • Ensure systems meet operational, performance, and safety requirements prior to production handoff.

System Installation & Integration

  • Install and integrate robotic arms, grippers, sensors, cameras, and mobile platforms.

  • Contribute directly to mechanical and electrical installation of robotic systems.

  • Mount and replace end-effectors such as grippers and tooling.

  • Route and secure electrical and communication cables within robotic cells and control cabinets.

  • Assist with installation, wiring, and modification of control cabinets and electrical components.

  • Drill, tap, mount, and modify brackets, fixtures, and mounting hardware as required for system integration.

  • Conduct on-site system testing and validation.

Troubleshooting & Optimization

  • Diagnose and resolve mechanical, electrical, and software issues during deployment.

  • Replace or repair hardware components such as grippers, sensors, actuators, and cabling.

  • Optimize system performance for efficiency, speed, and accuracy in production environments.

  • Provide technical training and support to customer teams.

  • Document installation procedures, configurations, and lessons learned from deployments.

  • Collaborate with internal engineering teams to improve system robustness and deployment processes.

  • Support customer sites across Europe remotely when not actively on deployment.

Travel

Willingness and ability to travel extensively across Europe (approximately 75%) is required for this role.

Qualifications:

Education and Experience

  • 3+ years of experience deploying robotic systems, automation equipment, or industrial machinery.

  • Experience leading or coordinating technical installations or field deployments.

  • Hands-on experience with robotic workcells, automation systems, or industrial equipment.

Skills

  • Knowledge of ROS 2, robotic system architecture, or industrial automation systems.

  • Proficiency in Python, C++, or similar programming languages.

  • Experience with containerization tools such as Docker is a plus.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills across mechanical, electrical, and software systems.

  • Comfortable working with hand tools, power tools, and mechanical equipment.

  • Experience installing sensors, routing cables, and integrating hardware in industrial environments.

  • Ability to read mechanical drawings, wiring diagrams, and system layouts.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Familiarity with 6-axis robots, AMRs, or other robotic platforms is a plus.


What We Offer:

  • Highly competitive compensation and excellent career development opportunities in a fast-growing company

  • Flexible working hours

  • Wellpass (gym membership)

  • Free Snacks, Beverages, Lunch and Dinner while in the office

  • Full coverage of accommodation, meals, and travel expenses while on deployment

  • A motivated team and an open corporate culture

description_html:
Who We Are:

We are a rapidly growing embodied AI company revolutionizing physical labor. Leveraging cutting-edge robotics and advanced artificial intelligence, we develop transformative technologies that redefine how work is done across warehouses and fulfillment operations worldwide. Our products represent the frontier of what intelligent, dexterous automation can do — and we are only getting started.

Overview:

We are seeking a Product Manager to own the full product lifecycles — from concept and roadmap to field deployment across 50+ production sites. This is a high ownership, cross functional role at the intersection of AI, robotics hardware, and industrial operations. You will be the connective tissue between our AI/R&D team, software & hardware engineering, solutions architects, and customers — translating real-world operational complexity into a product that runs autonomously at scale with minimal human supervision.

Your Responsibilities:

Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Own the product roadmap across hardware, software, AI, and field reliability

  • Set and defend priorities — monthly to annual — against commercial goals and technical constraints

AI & Technical Ownership

  • Shape training data strategy, model evaluation criteria, and deployment thresholds with the R&D team

  • Close the loop between field failure data and Cortex training

Customer & Field Collaboration

  • Spend time at production sites; turn operator observations and edge cases into structured requirements

  • Own capability specs, performance SLAs, and integration requirements for customer-facing delivery

Cross-functional Execution

  • Run a customer-driven backlog; prioritize by impact, frequency, & strategic fit

  • Sequence work with engineering leads; unblock dependencies and maintain momentum

  • Track KPIs: uptime, pick success rate, intervention rate, time-to-value

  • Be the product voice in pre-sales technical conversations, build product collateral for the commercial team


Education & Experience

  • Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, or related field

  • 5+ years in product management; 2+ years on robotics systems

  • Track record of shipping complex technical products in production

Technical Skills

  • Familiarity with robot software stacks (ROS2, Zenoh, motion planning, control, perception pipelines)

  • Can engage credibly with AI/ML teams on model evaluation and deployment criteria

  • Understands hardware-software co-design tradeoffs and their downstream software impact

Product Skills

  • Turns messy field signal and engineering constraints into clear, prioritized requirements

  • Prepare PRDs and technical briefs that engineering teams actually use

  • Basic awareness of EU Machinery Regulation, ISO 10218/15066, and AI Act obligations

  • Own the product narrative in pre-sales — and build the collateral that helps the commercial team win

Soft Skills

  • High agency; defines the path rather than waiting for one

  • Pushes back on commercial, supports engineering, challenges customers, and aligns leadership — often in the same week

  • Surfaces risks and constraints early with solutions and path forward

Nice to Have

  • Warehouse automation, AMR, or logistics tech background

  • Startup experience where scope was undefined

  • WMS integration or fleet management exposure

What We Offer:

  • Wellpass (gym membership)

  • Free meals at the workplace

  • Flexible working hours and the option to work from home when needed

  • A defining role shaping one of the most technically ambitious robotics products

  • Competitive compensation and excellent career development opportunities

Stuttgart / Baden-Württemberg, Germany

Lagerist / warehouse worker (m/f/d)

Full-time · On-site only · No remote work

Sereact GmbH develops AI-powered robotics and automation solutions. For our warehouse in the Stuttgart region, we are looking for a reliable, hands-on person who keeps things organized and ensures a smooth flow of goods.

  • Manual dexterity and a hands-on attitude

  • Team spirit and flexibility with changing tasks

  • Class B driving licence is a plus

  • Forklift licence is a plus, but not required

Details

  • Working hours: Full-time

  • Work location: on-site only (in-person); remote work is not possible for this role

Innovation through diversity

Unabhängig von deinem Hintergrund, deiner Herkunft, deiner Geschlechtsidentität oder deinen individuellen Voraussetzungen ist es deine Persönlichkeit, die uns interessiert. title: Senior Embedded Linux Engineer (all genders) - Yocto · Python · IoT Edge
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Wemolo
description_html:
This position sits close to the embedded world, but it isn't traditional microcontroller firmware work. You'll own the operating system foundation and platform layer of our IoT devices - building and evolving our next-generation embedded Linux image - and develop the Python application layer that runs on top of it, inside our dockerized main application.

You'll work down at the OS and hardware boundary while shipping features up in the application layer. Typical areas include:

  • Designing and maintaining our Yocto-based Linux distribution for ARM devices with limited compute

  • Security on device, inter-process communication, networking, scheduling, observation

  • Over-the-air (OTA) updates for both the OS and applications

  • Integrating peripherals - watchdog, modem, AI accelerator - and improving their observability

  • Bridging the system layer and the application layer through Python and Bash

The work spans from driver- and kernel-level integration in C/C++, to adapting our Linux distribution with Yocto to the underlying hardware layer, to debugging system-level failures such as memory leaks, up to writing the Python software that turns hardware capabilities into product features.

You will be expected to pass a live coding interview for this role.

What to expect

  • Embedded Linux Platform: Design, build, and continuously evolve the next generation of our Yocto-based Linux distribution for ARM-powered IoT devices

  • Application Development: Develop Python-based software that brings hardware capabilities to life and improves the reliability and performance of our products

  • System Integration: Work across the full stack—from kernel and driver integration to application development—connecting hardware, operating system, and product features

  • Device Reliability: Build secure, observable, and resilient systems, including OTA updates, networking, process communication, scheduling, and device monitoring

  • Debugging & Troubleshooting: Analyze and resolve complex issues across the platform, including kernel, drivers, networking, memory management, and application software

  • Ownership: Take end-to-end responsibility for your solutions, proactively improve our platform, and help shape engineering best practices

Inspire us by

  • Embedded Linux Expertise: Several years of experience developing Embedded Linux systems and confidence working with Linux internals, GNU tools, and Bash

  • Engineering Mindset: Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or equivalent practical experience

  • Yocto Experience: Proven experience building, customizing, and maintaining Linux images using Yocto

  • Systems Programming: Strong programming skills in at least one systems language such as C, C++, Rust, Go, or Java

  • Python Development: Experience developing Python applications or a strong motivation to make Python your primary development language

  • Low-Level Debugging: Hands-on experience with debugging tools such as GDB, tcpdump, Valgrind, UART, and JTAG, including troubleshooting memory leaks and system-level issues

  • Operating System Knowledge: Solid understanding of Linux internals, bootloaders, systemd, drivers, kernel concepts, networking, and Docker

  • Language Skills: Fluent English (C1)

Extra points for

  • Experience operating large-scale IoT fleets

  • Knowledge of industrial hardware, cameras, AI accelerators, modems, or network devices

  • Experience with computer vision, edge AI, or machine learning

  • Familiarity with MQTT and Protocol Buffers (ProtoBuf)

What we offer

  • Flexibility & Responsibility: Your workday, your performance – Our hybrid model empowers you to focus from home, get fresh perspectives during workation, and connect in person during our Anchor Days (Tuesday to Thursday)

  • Tailored Mobility: Full speed ahead – Whether it’s sustainable bike leasing or a public transport subsidy, we keep you flexible and on the move

  • Measurable goals: Our agile methods allow you to directly measure your impact on our product and company success

  • Team Culture & Networking: Real connections – also beyond the day-to-day. Celebrate successes with us at legendary team events and OKR parties

  • Productive Environment: Brainfood deluxe – Whether it's portafilter coffee, Bella&Bona online cafeteria, fresh fruit or our muesli bar – your wellbeing fuels your performance

  • Health & Balance: Stay in balance with EGYM Wellpass or Urban Sports Club – access 1,000+ gyms and wellness spots across Germany

  • Top Equipment & Ergonomics: Mac or Windows, in the office or remote – we make sure you’re set up for efficiency and comfort

  • Dress Code? Your Code: What you do matters more than what you wear – dress in whatever makes you feel your best

Innovation through diversity

Regardless of your background, origin, gender identity, or individual circumstances, it's your personality that interests us. That's why we're committed to building a culture of collaboration and respect, where every team member has a voice, can grow, and feels valued with us.

description_html:
Bist du bereit, die Lücke zwischen Product und Markt zu schließen?

Bei Wemolo leben wir #own(y)ourgrowth – mit einer klaren Vision, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und einem Umfeld, in dem Innovation und persönliche Entwicklung Hand in Hand gehen. Als eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Scale-ups in Deutschland revolutionieren wir das Parkraummanagement durch smarte Software und AI-gestützte Technologie.

Die Challenge: Neue Features werden gebaut, aber noch nicht konsequent in Umsatz übersetzt. Produktwissen erreicht das Sales-Team oft unvollständig, und Marktfeedback kommt zu spät im Product-Team an.

Deine Rolle: Als GTM Enablement Manager (all genders) bist du das bindende Glied zwischen Product und Commercial. Verankert im Business Development Team sorgst du für ein nahtloses Zusammenspiel und treibst gleichzeitig strategische Themen voran, die das Wachstum von Wemolo direkt beeinflussen.

What to expect

  • Schnittstellen-Ownership: Du verantwortest die Schnittstelle zwischen Commercial und Product – von der strukturierten Bedarfsanalyse im Sales-Team bis zur priorisierten Übergabe an das Produktmanagement sowie den Rückfluss an Sales

  • Roadmap & Marktfeedback: Du stellst sicher, dass Kunden- und Marktfeedback direkt in die Produkt-Roadmap einfließen – daten- und business-case-getrieben, statt nach Bauchgefühl

  • Sales Enablement: Du besitzt das Product Playbook aus kommerzieller Sicht und übersetzt neue Features und Release Notes in klare, verkaufsstarke Value Propositions statt technischer Datenblätter

  • Teamübergreifende Kollaboration: Als bindendes Glied zwischen Product, Sales, Marketing und Operations strukturierst du das Alignment, treibst Entscheidungen voran und berichtest direkt an den Head of Business Development

Inspire us by

  • Experience: Du bringst 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung an der Schnittstelle zwischen Product und Commercial mit (z. B. als Product Marketing Manager, Business Analyst im SaaS-Umfeld, Tech-Consultant oder Business Development Manager mit starkem Produktfokus) – idealerweise in einem B2B Scale-up oder Startup

  • Commercial Mindset: Du denkst in Umsatz und Impact – für dich ist ein Feature erst dann erfolgreich, wenn es sich verkauft. Komplexe Produktwelten übersetzt du mühelos in echten Kundennutzen

  • Strukturiertes Arbeiten: Du priorisierst konsequent, arbeitest hypothesengetrieben und baust skalierbare Prozesse für die Zukunft auf

  • Stakeholder Management: Du kommunizierst souverän und auf Augenhöhe mit Product Managern, Sales-Teams und Commercial Leads – dabei kannst du moderieren, eskalieren und Teams alignment-fokussiert zusammenbringen

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du hast C2 Deutschkenntnisse und sprichst verhandlungssicheres Englisch, weitere Fremdsprachenkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.


What we offer

  • Flexibilität & Eigenverantwortung: Dein Arbeitsalltag, deine Performance - Unser hybrides Modell ermöglicht dir fokussiertes arbeiten im Homeoffice, frische Perspektiven in der Workation sowie persönlichen Austausch an unseren Anchor-Days (Dienstag bis Donnerstag)

  • Mobilität nach Maß: Volle Fahrt voraus - Ob nachhaltig mit Bike-Leasing oder bequem mit Fahrtkostenzuschuss, wir halten dich mobil und flexibel auf Kurs

  • Dresscode? Dein Code: Bei uns zählt, was du bewegst – nicht, was du trägst. Zieh an, worin du dich am wohlsten fühlst

 

Innovation through diversity

Unabhängig von deinem Hintergrund, deiner Herkunft, deiner Geschlechtsidentität oder deinen individuellen Voraussetzungen ist es deine Persönlichkeit, die uns interessiert. Deshalb schaffen wir eine Kultur des Miteinanders und des Respekts, in der jedes Teammitglied ein Mitspracherecht hat, sich persönlich weiterentwickeln kann und wertgeschätzt fühlt.

 

Still here?
Dann könnten wir ein perfektes Match sein!

Bewirb dich am besten über unser Bewerbungsportal - so landet deine Bewerbung direkt bei uns im Team und wir können sie schnell und unkompliziert prüfen.

title: Product Manager - AI Neobank App

description_html:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

 

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Mobile Application Developer - AI Neobank App
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Bjak
description_html:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for Android engineers to build the native Android experience for Doit's AI Neobank App.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

 

What You'll Own

  • Build and ship Android features using Kotlin.

  • Create clean mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.

  • Work with product and design to simplify complex user journeys.

  • Integrate backend APIs and ensure mobile flows are stable, secure and reliable.

  • Improve app performance, crash rate, loading states, responsiveness and memory usage.

  • Use analytics, user behaviour and production issues to improve the product.

  • Build AI-assisted mobile experiences only where they genuinely improve the user journey.

 

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin.

  • Strong Android fundamentals and experience shipping production apps.

  • Good knowledge of Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android architecture.

  • Strong sense of mobile UX, usability, edge cases and user flows.

  • Experience integrating REST APIs and debugging production issues.

  • Fast execution, high ownership and strong attention to product quality.

  • App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.

 

Tech Stack

  • Kotlin

  • Jetpack Compose

  • Android SDK

  • Coroutines & Flow

  • SQL / NoSQL

  • TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks in user journeys, not just screens.

  • Cares about making complex financial products feel simple.

  • Moves fast without creating messy code.

  • Notices UX, performance and reliability issues before users complain.

  • Honest about what they personally built, what was team-owned and what impact they can or cannot claim.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round


For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

description_html:
🎤 Founders Associate - a letter from the person you'd work with

Most job ads are written by no one, for everyone. I want to do this differently.

I'm Marius, Chief of Staff at voize. This role reports to me, and whoever takes it will work more closely with me than anyone else in the company. So instead of a template, here's what this job is, how I work, and how you can decide whether you'd want to work with me.

💡 What this job actually is

voize is growing fast, and fast-growing companies produce a specific kind of work: topics that matter but belong to no one. A new market needs operational groundwork. An org-wide process needs to be built. A decision needs a sharp analysis behind it. We're building a CEO Office to own exactly this work. You'd be its first hire.

I’ll be honest about the range. One week you’re working on a question that I and the rest of the management team will decide the company’s direction on. The next you're doing operational groundwork nobody will ever applaud. Both matter equally, it's the nature of building an early-stage company. If you need every task to feel glamorous, stop reading here. If "done" is your favorite word, keep going.

To make it concrete, your first months could look like this: you own the operational groundwork for one of our new markets end-to-end - research, vendor and partner setup, local operations - until things simply run. And you build one company-wide process from scratch, for example how cross-functional projects get scoped, prioritized, and tracked, and roll it out across the org. Different altitude, same job: you drive it to done.

🚀 How I work

I give trust and autonomy by default. The way I see my job as a manager: set goals you can actually reach, give you the resources to get there, unblock you when you're stuck, teach you what I know - and then get out of the way. I care about outcomes, not hours.

The flip side: you'll get a lot of freedom and little oversight. That's a gift if you work autonomously, and a problem if you don't. Autonomy doesn't mean silence, though. I expect you to ask for help early, not after something has quietly derailed.

I'm very opinionated and direct. You'll always know where you stand with me, and I expect the same back - including telling me when you think I'm wrong.

🎯 What I look for

Your background matters less than your pattern. You might come from consulting, VC, a startup, or something you built yourself. What I care about is this: you take ownership before anyone assigns it. You can be dropped into a topic you know nothing about and produce clarity within days. You hold a high bar for your own work without anyone checking. You ask a sharp question early instead of defending a wrong assumption late. And pace gives you energy instead of draining it.

If you read that and felt recognized rather than impressed - good sign.

🌱 Why voize

The care crisis is one of the most existential problems we face: fewer and fewer people caring for more and more of us. We build something that genuinely helps - over 200,000 caregivers use voize to win back time for people instead of paperwork. Purpose usually comes at the price of ambition. Not here. We combine real impact with high ambition and high speed, and that combination is rare. We raised a $50m Series A from leading investors like Balderton and HV end of last year and there is a lot ahead of us.

🤝 The deal

This job will be intense, and it will be fun. You'll get more exposure in your first year than most roles offer in five - to the CEO, me, the rest of the management team, and every part of the company. I'll invest in your growth personally. And the role isn't fixed: you'll shape it into what you want it to become.

If you read this and think this is for you, please apply no matter who you are or what background you have! I want to meet you 🫶

Marius

description_html:
Einleitung

Als Senior Customer Support Specialist übernimmst Du eine Schlüsselrolle in unserem 10-köpfigen Team und prägst die Servicequalität von Peter Park maßgeblich. Wir digitalisieren die Parkbranche und verwandeln gewöhnliche Parkplätze in smarte Mobility Hubs.

Für dieses Wachstum suchen wir eine erfahrene Persöhnlichkeit, die nicht nur komplexe Kundenanliegen souverän löst, sondern auch Verantwortung für den Wissensaufbau im Team übernimmt. Diese Position bietet Dir die konkrete Perspektive, Dich schrittweise in Richtung Teamleitung weiterzuentwickeln und Führungsverantwortung aufzubauen.


Was ist Deine Aufgabe?

  • Mentoring & Teamentwicklung: Fachliche Anleitung, Einarbeitung und kontinuierliches Coaching von Junior-Kolleginnen und -Kollegen sowie Förderung des Wissensaustauschs im Team.

  • Perspektive Teamleitung: Aktive Mitgestaltung von Teamstrukturen und Support-Prozessen mit dem Ziel, sukzessive mehr organisatorische und operative Führungsverantwortung zu übernehmen.

  • Eskalationsmanagement: Eigenverantwortliche Bearbeitung von anspruchsvollen, komplexen oder rechtlich/technisch sensiblen Anfragen (2nd & 3rd Level Support) aus dem 1st Level.

  • Prozess- & CRM-Optimierung: Strategische Weiterentwicklung unserer Support-Workflows, Etablierung von Best Practices und Optimierung unseres Ticket-Systems (z. B. Zendesk/HubSpot).

  • Schnittstellen- & KPI-Management: Auswertung von Support-Daten zur Identifikation von Fehlerquellen und enge Zusammenarbeit mit Product, Tech, Legal und Sales zur nachhaltigen Produktverbesserung.

  • Compliance & Datenschutz: Souveräne Handhabung von herausfordernden Fragestellungen rund um Datenschutz und Vertragsbedingungen.


Deine Fähigkeiten:

  • Berufserfahrung: Mindestens 4 bis 5 Jahre fundierte Erfahrung im Customer Support, Kundenservice oder Customer Relationship Management, idealerweise in einem skalierenden SaaS-, Tech- oder Start-up-Umfeld.

  • Mentoring- & Führungspotenzial: Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der fachlichen Anleitung oder Einarbeitung von Teammitgliedern sowie der klare Wunsch, den nächsten Schritt Richtung Teamleitung zu gehen.

  • Prozess- & Tool-Expertise: Exzellente Kenntnisse im Umgang mit CRM- und Ticket-Systemen (z. B. Zendesk, HubSpot, Freshdesk) sowie ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für datengetriebene Support-Prozesse.

  • Analytische Stärke & Souveränität: Ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität, hohes Durchsetzungsvermögen und ein ruhiges, professionelles Auftreten – auch in eskalierten Situationen.

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2) sowie verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.


Work Setup:

  • 40 Stunden pro Woche (Vertrauensbasis)
  • Arbeitszeiten: Montag bis Freitag, keine Schichtarbeit
  • Homeoffice Policy: 3 Tage im Office / 2 Tage remote 
  • Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag
  • Arbeitsort: München
  • Team: 10 Kolleg:innen


Welche Vorteile bietet mir Peter Park?

  • Arbeiten mit Bergblick: Modernes Büro in der Neuen Balan mit Dachterrasse, Alpenpanorama, Teamevents und Sommer-Grillabenden.

  • Weiterentwicklung & Impact: Flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege und der gezielte Freiraum, eine Führungsrolle aktiv aufzubauen.

  • Zusatzleistungen: Wahlweise bezuschusstes Deutschlandticket oder EGYM Wellpass, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Corporate Benefits und Jobrad-Leasing.

  • Flexibilität: 29 Urlaubstage, flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zur EU-Workation.

  • Equipment & Wohlbefinden: Ergonomischer Arbeitsplatz mit höhenverstellbaren Tischen, modernes Apple-Setup, kostenlose Snacks, bezuschusstes Office-Catering und wöchentlicher Team-Lunch.

✅ Bereit für den nächsten Schritt?
Dann werde Teil unseres Teams – und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft! Bewirb dich einfach und schnell über den Button unten "Auf diese Stelle bewerben" Wir freuen uns, von Dir zu hören!

title: Senior Account Manager (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Peter Park
description_html:
Einleitung

Du willst nicht einfach nur Kunden verwalten, sondern ein eigenes Portfolio strategischer B2B-Kunden von Grund auf skalieren? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig.

Wir stellen unseren B2B-Bereich gerade neu auf – und Du kommst als eine:r der ersten Senior Account Manager:innen an Bord. In dieser Rolle prägst Du von Tag eins an mit, wie diese Funktion bei Peter Park funktioniert, und übernimmst echte kommerzielle Verantwortung: Du sicherst wiederkehrende Umsätze über hohe Kundenbindung, treibst die Standort-Expansion voran und verkaufst zusätzliche Services an bestehenden Standorten. Du berichtest direkt an den Team Lead Account Management.


Was ist Deine Aufgabe?

  • End-to-End Portfolio Ownership: Du verantwortest ein eigenes Portfolio unserer strategisch wichtigsten Kunden von A bis Z. Mit klaren Accountplänen behältst Du die Relevanz und die Decision-Maker je Kunde immer fest im Blick.

  • Proaktive Expansionsstrategie: Gemeinsam mit dem Sales-Team entwickelst Du für jeden Account eine maßgeschneiderte Expansionsstrategie – von der Standortanalyse über den Business Case bis zur gezielten Ansprache.

  • Upselling an Bestandsstandorten: Du erkennst Potenziale an bestehenden Standorten frühzeitig und wandelst Signale eigenständig in unterschriebene Vertragsnachträge um.

  • Strategische Business Reviews: Du führst regelmäßige Reviews mit Deinen Kunden durch, analysierst Entwicklungen und behältst die Performance Deines gesamten Portfolios vorausschauend im Griff.

  • Erste Ansprechperson mit Lösungsstärke: Kommerziell wie operativ bist Du die zentrale Vertrauensperson für Deine Kunden. Bei komplexen technischen Themen oder Kapazitätsfragen holst Du gezielt Customer Success mit an Board.

  • Datenbasiertes Account Management: Du steuerst Deine Accounts über harte KPIs (Umsatzentwicklung, NPS, CSAT, Health Score) und handelst proaktiv, bevor aus einem Risiko eine Kündigung entsteht.

  • Zentrale Schnittstelle & Escalation Level: Du agierst als Bindeglied zwischen Tech, Product, Operations und Vertrieb und bist die letzte interne Eskalationsstufe, bevor die Führungsebene übernimmt.

  • Mentorship & Teamentwicklung: Du gibst Dein Wissen aktiv weiter und unterstützt als Mentor:in die Entwicklung unserer Junior- und Mid-Level-Kolleg:innen.


Was Du mitbringen solltest:

  • Erfahrung: 5+ Jahre B2B Account Management mit einem nachweisbar starken Track Record.

  • Kommerzielles Handwerk: Du beherrschst Preislogiken, Vertragsverhandlungen und Business Cases auf Basis fester Kundendaten statt Bauchgefühl. Du verbindest Kundenbedürfnisse mit unseren Business-Zielen – inklusive einem begründeten "Nein", wenn nötig.

  • Ownership & Haltung: Du übernimmst volle Verantwortung für Deine Kunden und kommunizierst Zielabweichungen direkt mit einem konkreten Lösungsvorschlag.

  • Datenfokus: Diszipliniertes Arbeiten im CRM (HubSpot ist ein Plus) gehört für Dich dazu. Du liest Health Scores und Standortdaten mühelos und leitest daraus klare Actions ab.

  • Übersetzer-Kompetenz: Du denkst Dich schnell in unsere Produkt- und Systemwelt ein und übersetzt komplexe technische Setups so, dass nicht-technische Entscheider:innen leicht Ja sagen können.

  • Resilienz & Priorisierung: In harten kommerziellen Gesprächen bleibst Du souverän und priorisierst Deine Aufgaben konsequent nach Impact und Wert.

  • Sprachen: Deutsch und Englisch verhandlungssicher (C1+). Weitere Sprachen von Vorteil


Work Setup:

  • Arbeitsmodell: 40 Std./Woche (Vertrauensarbeitszeit) mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten

  • München Hybrid: 3 Tage Office in der Neuen Balan / 2 Tage remote, plus regelmäßige Vor-Ort-Termine bei Deinen Kunden im DACH-Raum

  • Vertrag & Vergütung: Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag, attraktives Fixgehalt plus leistungsbasierter Bonus

  • Perspektive: Klare Entwicklungspfade – wahlweise als Fachkraft (Expert) oder Führungskraft (Team Lead)

  • Team: Ein ambitioniertes Team aus aktuell 5 Kolleg:innen


Welche Vorteile bietet mir Peter Park?

So ticken wir! Passt das zu Dir?

  • Own & Prioritize: „Nicht mein Job“ gibt's bei uns nicht. Du übernimmst und ziehst durch.

  • Think Big: Wir denken in Portfolios, nicht in Einzeldeals.

  • Bias for Action: Wir entscheiden schnell und justieren im Gehen nach.

  • Have Backbone, Disagree & Commit: Du sagst früh, was Du denkst und ziehst mit, wenn entschieden ist.

Deine Vorteile

  • Vertrauensbasiertes, flexibles Arbeiten im Office mit Alpenblick in der neuen Balan oder remote.

  • Start-up-Flair trotz Wachstumstempo: kurze Wege, Duz-Kultur vom Werksstudent bis zum CEO.

  • Attraktives Fixgehalt plus leistungsbasierter Bonus.

  • Eigenverantwortung, Feedback-Kultur, steile Lernkurve und die Chance, eine ganze Enterprise-Motion von Grund auf mitzugestalten.

  • 29 Urlaubstage, Team-Events, IT-Ausstattung Deiner Wahl, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Urban Sports Club, Essenszuschuss, wöchentlicher Team-Lunch.

  • EU-Workation: Du kannst auch mal von einem anderen EU-Land aus arbeiten.


Klingt nach Dir? Schick uns Deine Bewerbung an ----- Wir freuen uns auf Dich!

description_html:
About the role

Gauss Fusion is looking for a creative and hands-on Working Student to support its communications activities at our headquarters in Garching bei München.
 
The role will have a particular focus on visual and digital communications, helping to turn complex scientific, engineering and corporate information into clear and engaging communications materials.
 
You will support the development of social and digital content, visual assets and other branded materials, while also contributing to German-language communications, media and industry monitoring, and the practical coordination of communications activity.
 
You will work closely with the person leading/supporting Gauss Fusion’s communications activity and with colleagues across the company to gather information and turn it into effective communications outputs.
 
This is an execution-focused role offering practical experience within a fast-moving scientific and industrial environment.


Main responsibilities

  • Create and adapt visual assets for social and digital communications, including graphics and other supporting content.
  • Support the visual presentation of complex scientific, technical and corporate information in a clear and accessible way.
  • Assist with the production and coordination of social media content, particularly for LinkedIn.
  • Help maintain communications and content plans, gather inputs from colleagues and support the timely preparation of planned content.
  • Provide practical creative support for branded materials and visual communications within the Garching office environment.
  • Support the preparation and adaptation of German-language communications, including translation between English and German where required.
  • Monitor relevant media coverage, industry developments and competitor activity and help compile concise updates for internal stakeholders.
  • Provide other practical and execution-focused communications support as required.


Qualification and educational requirements

  • Currently enrolled in a bachelor’s or master’s degree programme in Communication, Journalism, Marketing, or a comparable discipline.
  • Fluent or native-level German, with strong written and spoken English.
  • Strong visual and digital capabilities, with an ability to present information clearly and effectively.
  • Good understanding of contemporary social and digital communications channels.
  • Ability to understand complex information and translate it into accessible visual or written communications outputs.


Competences and preferred skills

Competence

  • Creative mindset combined with strong attention to detail.
  • Structured, organised and reliable working style.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned tasks.
  • Comfortable managing multiple activities and deadlines in a dynamic environment.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and confidence gathering information from colleagues across different functions.
  • Curious and willing to learn about complex scientific, engineering and industrial topics.
  • Sound judgement about how information should be presented for different audiences and formats.

 

Preferred Skills

  • Previous experience creating visual or digital communications content through university projects, internships, employment or comparable activities.
  • Familiarity with commonly used graphic design, presentation and digital content-creation tools.
  • Experience supporting or managing content for LinkedIn or other contemporary digital channels.
  • Some experience of information design, particularly presenting complex material in a simple and visually effective way.
  • Experience translating or adapting communications content between German and English.
  • Interest in science, engineering, energy, technology or other complex industrial sectors.

  • Aussagekräftiges Portfolio: Arbeitsproben, die konzeptionelle Stärke, exzellente Gestaltung und sichere crossmediale Umsetzung belegen

  • Konzeptionelle und strategische Denkweise: Du kannst komplexe Inhalte strukturieren und Markenstrategien in klare visuelle Leitideen übersetzen

  • Sehr gute Toolkenntnisse: Sicherer Umgang mit Adobe Creative Cloud, insbesondere Photoshop, Illustrator und InDesign; Figma sowie After Effects oder Premiere sind von Vorteil

description_html:
Unternehmensbeschreibung

Die dpa-IT Services GmbH ist das IT-Rückgrat der Deutschen Presse-Agentur (dpa) - einer der führenden unabhängigen Nachrichtenagenturen weltweit. Als Tochterunternehmen der dpa verantworten wir IT-Infrastruktur, geschäftskritische Anwendungen, moderne Cloud- und Rechenzentrumsinfrastrukturen sowie digitale Arbeitsplätze für die gesamte dpa-Gruppe.

Du möchtest praktische Erfahrungen sammeln und aktiv an IT- und Informationssicherheitsthemen mitarbeiten? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Informationssicherheits-Teams suchen wir ab dem 01.11.2026 am Standort Hamburg eine/n Werkstudenten/in (m/w/d) für bis zu 20 Stunden/Woche, zunächst befristet auf ein Jahr.


Der Job + Die Verantwortung

  • Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung und Pflege von Sicherheitsrichtlinien und -konzepten. 
  • Du begleitest die Bewertung von Risiken, neuer Tools und KI-Lösungen aus Sicht der Informationssicherheit und dokumentierst deine Ergebnisse nachvollziehbar.
  • Du analysierst und dokumentierst Sicherheitsanforderungen und Prozesse und unterstützt bei der Ableitung und Nachverfolgung von Maßnahmen.
  • Du wirkst bei der Durchführung von Awareness-Maßnahmen (z.B. Trainings, Phishing-Simulationen, Notfallübungen, Newsletter) mit.
  • Du recherchierst aktuelle Sicherheits- und Compliance-Themen und bereitest deine Ergebnisse für das Team auf.
  • Du erstellst Präsentationen, Auswertungen und Dokumentationen.


Du + Deine Stärken

  • Laufendes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, IT/Cyber-Sicherheit, Informationsmanagement oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs (bitte Immatrikulationsbescheinigung einreichen).
  • Grundlegendes Verständnis und/oder erste praktische Erfahrung im Bereich IT, IT/Cyber-Sicherheit oder IT-Compliance sind wünschenswert
  • Erste Kenntnisse in Informationssicherheitsstandards wie ISO 27001 oder BSI-Grundschutz sind ein Plus, aber kein Muss.
  • Gute MS-Office Kenntnisse 
  • Strukturierte, sorgfältige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise
  • Du kannst Ergebnisse klar und verständlich aufbereiten und scheust dich nicht, deine Meinung einzubringen.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab


Wir + Unsere Kultur

  • Echte Einblicke in die Welt der IT- und Informationssicherheit 
  • Abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben mit Spielraum für Ideen und Ausgestaltung 
  • Ein erfahrenes Team, das dich fachlich begleitet und bei deiner Entwicklung unterstützt. 
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich gut mit deinem Studium vereinbaren lassen
  • Moderner Arbeitsplatz direkt an der Alster und mit hauseigener Kantine
  • Mobiles Arbeiten in Abstimmung mit deiner Führungskraft möglich 
  • Eine faire Vergütung 


Klingt gut?

Wenn du Lust hast, die Informationssicherheit bei Deutschlands größter Nachrichtenagentur mitzugestalten, dann bewirb dich einfach und schnell über unser Onlineformular. Deine HR-Ansprechperson ist Celine Bock.

title: Senior Legal Counsel (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Qplix
description_html:
IN A NUTSHELL

As a fast-growing SaaS provider in the WealthTech space, we are expanding internationally. Following the successful launch of our Zurich hub, our next milestone is entering the UK market. To support this exciting growth journey, we are looking for an experienced Legal Counsel who will help shape and scale our legal function while acting as a pragmatic business partner across the organization.


Your mission

  • Provide legal advice on a broad range of commercial and corporate matters.
  • Draft, review and negotiate national and international contracts, with a focus on SaaS, software, customer, partner and supplier agreements.
  • Support our international expansion, particularly our UK market entry.
  • Build and continuously improve scalable legal processes, contract templates and governance frameworks.
  • Partner closely with Sales, Product, Finance and Management, while coordinating external legal counsel where required.
  • Support data protection, compliance and corporate housekeeping matters.
  • Drive the adoption of Legal Tech and AI-powered solutions to improve legal operations.


Your profile

  • Fully qualified lawyer with at least 5 years of professional experience, ideally gained in an international company and/or a leading commercial law firm.
  • Strong background in commercial law and extensive experience negotiating technology, software or SaaS agreements.
  • Solid understanding of UK law/Common Law and experience supporting international business operations.
  • Proven ability to build processes and structures in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Pragmatic, business-oriented mindset with strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Interest in Legal Tech, contract automation and AI-enabled legal workflows.
  • Business fluent in German and English
Nice to have
  • Experience in an international scale-up environment.
  • Familiarity with GDPR and general compliance topics.
  • Experience with Legal Tech / CLM tools (e.g. Ironclad, Juro, DocuSign CLM) and AI-supported legal workflows.


Why us?

  • Shape the legal function of a rapidly growing international SaaS company
  • Take ownership from day one
  • Work closely with leadership on international expansion
  • Modern, collaborative and fast-paced environment based in Munich

title: Senior Software Engineer - Ruby on Rails (f/m/d)

description_html:
Are you ready to change the market?

At PAIR Finance we're building the AI-driven platform that's redefining debt collection across Europe. We're looking for a senior software engineer who takes ownership end-to-end, is comfortable being the technical driver of a well-defined scope, and is energized by learning a deep, high-stakes domain: the legal processes around In-Court and After-Court debt collection.


Your Responsibilities:

  • Own a clear scope end-to-end: take initiative from idea to production largely independently, and lead within your team (T-shaped: you go deep on your slice, and pair with one other developer)
  • Design, build, and run POCs quickly to de-risk decisions before committing to a full build
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain our core backend applications and services
  • Work on high-level architecture to ensure scalability, performance, availability, and security
  • Go deep on the In-Court/After-Court domain (the legal and procedural knowledge behind our
    collection processes is a core part of the job, not a side detail) 
  • Collaborate closely with product to shape the roadmap and unlock further company growth
  • Work AI-augmented: you already use (or are ready to adopt) tools like Claude Code as part of how you build, review, and ship
  • Help evolve and enhance our AI-based platform
  • Stay current with industry trends and bring ideas back to the team


What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 1+ year on medium-to-large
    projects
  • Strong backend experience in Ruby (Ruby on Rails): this is our core stack, and required for the
    role
  • Language-agnostic mindset: you pick the right tool for the job (hands-on experience with Go and/or Python is a big plus) 
  • Proven ability to work independently: scope, drive, and deliver a project with minimal hand-holding
  • Experience with TDD and CI/CD
  • A track record of writing clean, maintainable backend code and solid infrastructure
  • Comfortable in an Agile environment (Scrum, Kanban)
  • Genuine interest in working with, and building on top of, AI-based technologies
  • Solid English communication skills
Nice to have:
  • Experience in the financial or accounting industry 
  • Frontend development experience, especially Vue.js and GraphQL knowledge
  • Infrastructure experience: AWS, Terraform (IaC), Docker, Linux

  • Knowledge of other backend technologies, such as Node.js, Rust, or Java


Our offer for you:

  • For this senior-level role, our salary band is €77,000 - €92,000 gross per year (based on a 40-hour work week). The exact offer will reflect your experience and qualifications
  • We offer visa sponsorship
  • Thriving, financially stable company
  • Strong experienced international team to support and mentor you along the way, smooth onboarding process
  • International team of 30+ nationalities with professionals and experts
  • Flat hierarchy, transparent and appreciative feedback culture, monthly all hands meetings, annual feedback and evaluation cycle, regular 1-on-1s with your lead
  • Well-structured onboarding process as well as supportive and welcoming colleagues
  • Personal learning & development budget as well as German and English language courses
  • Unlimited employment contract, flexible working hours and 28 vacation days for your work-life balance
  • Company pension plan, partly covered Deutschlandticket (public transport) and access to “Corporate Benefits”-voucher platform to ensure your full well-being
  • Fun company summer and Christmas parties as well as regular team events
  • This role is based in Berlin, and we have a hybrid working policy. Modern office near Uhlandstr. is complete with fresh fruit, muesli and drinks for a comfortable and enjoyable workplace


Who is your contact person?

Your contact person for this position is Geneva Brooks. If you have any questions, please contact us directly by email ----- - we look forward to hearing from you!

For more information about PAIR Finance, please take a look at our website and our careers page.

title: Senior Collection Specialist Quality (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Pair
description_html:
Are you ready to change the market?

PAIR Finance is reimagining debt collection: We've developed the most advanced AI technology in receivables management, fundamentally transforming the entire collections industry. Today, with over 260 employees, 600+ clients, and 10+ European entities, we're leading the way in AI-powered receivables management - delivering higher recovery rates while protecting our clients customer relationships.

You're responsible for the quality of our collection processes and teams. You develop trainings and document processes that enable your colleagues to deliver consistently high-quality work. Based on sample insights, you analyze gaps, identify improvement opportunities, and directly translate these into optimized trainings and processes. You're the bridge between operations and quality assurance - with a focus on measurable results and continuous improvement.

You work internationally with teams across different markets, expanding our documentation and training materials to new European markets.

Ready to join us? We'd love to see your application!


Your Responsibilities:

  • Training Design, Delivery & Quality Improvement: You develop, implement, and optimize trainings and learning paths. Through regular sample analyses conducted by the team, you identify gaps and directly translate improvements into new trainings
  • Process documentation & expansion: You document, update, and expand our process documentation to additional European markets (such as the UK)
  • Knowledge management: You build and structure a knowledge database that serves as a foundation for AI-powered tools and support the quality management department in AI-driven processes
  • Data-driven optimization: You leverage our KPI reporting for continuous improvement of our quality standards
  • International collaboration: You work cross-functionally with teams across other entities and squads to anchor processes and documentation locally


What we're looking for:

Must-Haves

  • Experience: Minimum 3+ years at senior level in Training & Documentation and/or Quality Management
  • Languages: Fluent in English, German knowledge is beneficial 
  • Technical competence: Experience with Learning Management Systems or learning path design; familiarity with process documentation and process optimization
  • Industry knowledge: Strong understanding of internationally varying regulatory requirements, ideally in Collections and/or Data Protection
  • AI tools: Basic understanding of AI-powered tools such as Claude and their practical application
  • Soft skills: Independent, structured work style with ownership mentality and strong written and verbal communication skills
Nice-to-Haves
  • Experience in the collections industry or other heavily regulated sectors (Legal, Finance, Compliance)
  • Knowledge of another European language
  • Experience with Debt Collection in the UK and applicable regulatory requirements
  • Familiarity with SharePoint and the Microsoft 365 ecosystem
  • Experience with Instructional Design (ID) Frameworks, Content Management, or Knowledge Engineering

Our Values
At PAIR Finance, customer-centricity, transparency, and integrity are at the heart of everything we do - and every team member lives these values. We're also driven by innovation and the ambition to actively shape what we do. Do you see yourself reflected in these values? We'd love to meet you!


Our offer for you:

Work Environment

  • Hybrid work model with 2-3 days on-site per week at our modern office in Berlin-Charlottenburg
  • You'll work alongside professional colleagues and experts from over 30 nationalities
  • Your colleagues will support you from day one with advice and practical help, ensuring a warm welcome
  • Transparent feedback & annual development conversations, monthly all-hands meetings, and flat hierarchies
Benefits
  • Permanent employment contract, flexible working hours, and 28 vacation days
  • For this senior position, our salary band is €47,000 - €57,000 per year (based on a 40-hour week). The exact offer depends on your experience and qualifications. We're also open to strong mid-level candidates - in that case, the salary would be below this range
  • Subsidy for Germany ticket plus access to corporate benefits
  • Annual summer and winter parties in Berlin, plus regular team events
Career & Development
  • Challenging, diverse tasks that fuel your steep learning curve
  • Individual training budget and language courses


Our Interview Process:

  • First online interview with Jasmin (Talent Acquisition Specialist): 30-45 minutes
    We get to know you, your motivation and background, and you'll get first insights into PAIR Finance and the role.
  • Second online interview with Sandra (Team Lead Quality Collection): 60 minutes
    We'll dive deeper into your experience and the position. This is your chance to learn more about the tasks, challenges, and the team.
  • Third on-site interview with the entire team: 60 minutes
    We'll conduct a case study during this conversation. Please plan for approximately 1–2 hours of preparation time. We'll assess your functional knowledge, discuss collaboration with internal stakeholders and within the team.


Who is your contact person?

Your point of contact for this position is Jasmin Baldrich. If you have any questions, feel free to send us an email at

Learn more about PAIR Finance and our work environment on our website and career page.

title: Senior Brand & Visual Designer (m/w/d) Elternzeitvertretung
